title.zh: 卷四十三 本紀第四十三 理宗三
title.raw: 卷四十三 本紀第四十三 理宗三 Volume 43 Annals 43: Lizong 3

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬寅朔，詔邊將毋擅興暴掠，虐殺無辜，以慰中原遺黎之望。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month of spring, on renyin the new moon day, an edict ordered border generals not to undertake raiding on their own authority, cruelly kill the innocent, so as to comfort the hopes of the remnant populace of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, renyin, an edict forbade border commanders from launching raids on their own or slaughtering innocents, so as to reassure the remnant people of the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 帝制《訓廉》、《謹刑》二銘，戒飭中外。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed two inscriptions, "Instruction in Integrity" and "Caution in Punishment," to admonish the court and the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed two inscriptions, Instruction in Integrity and Caution in Punishment, as admonitions to the court and the realm.

sentences.zh: 以李鳴復參知政事，杜範同知樞密院事，劉伯正簽書樞密院事，余玠華文閣待制、依舊四川安撫制置使、知重慶府兼四川總領財賦，李曾伯寶章閣直學士、依舊淮東安撫制置使、知揚州兼淮西制置使。

translations.literal: Li Mingfu was made Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Du Fan Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Liu Bozheng Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Jie Attendant Gentleman of the Huawen Pavilion, continuing as Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, Prefect of Chongqing, and concurrent Sichuan Fiscal Commissioner; Li Zengbo Direct Academician of the Baozhang Pavilion, continuing as Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, Prefect of Yangzhou, and concurrent Huaixi Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mingfu was appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Du Fan vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Liu Bozheng associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Jie attendant gentleman of the Huawen Pavilion, retaining his posts as Sichuan pacification commissioner, prefect of Chongqing, and concurrent Sichuan fiscal commissioner; and Li Zengbo direct academician of the Baozhang Pavilion, retaining his posts as Huaidong pacification commissioner, prefect of Yangzhou, and concurrent Huaixi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，樞密院言：「四川帥臣余玠，大小三十六戰，多有勞效，宜第功行賞。

translations.literal: On wuwu the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "The Sichuan commander Yu Jie fought thirty-six engagements large and small, with many meritorious results; his achievements should be ranked and rewarded."
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Bureau of Military Affairs reported that the Sichuan commander Yu Jie had fought thirty-six engagements, large and small, with considerable success, and that his achievements should be ranked and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 」詔玠趣上立功將士姓名等第，即與推恩。

translations.literal: "An edict ordered Yu Jie to submit promptly the names and ranks of meritorious officers and soldiers, and rewards were to be conferred at once.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yu Jie to submit promptly the names and merit ranks of the officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves, with rewards to follow immediately.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以余玠兼四川屯田使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Yu Jie was additionally made Sichuan Commissioner of Military Colonies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yu Jie was additionally appointed Sichuan commissioner of military colonies.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，出封樁庫緡錢各十萬，命兩淮、京湖、四川制司收瘞頻年交兵遺骸，立爲義塚。

translations.literal: In the second month on guiyou, one hundred thousand strings of cash each were disbursed from the sealed reserve treasury, ordering the Huai circuits, Jing-Hu, and Sichuan commissioners to gather and bury the remains from years of warfare and establish public burial mounds.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, one hundred thousand strings of cash each were released from the sealed reserve treasury and the Huai, Jing-Hu, and Sichuan commissioners were ordered to collect and bury the remains left by years of fighting and to establish public burial mounds.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，有流星大如太白，出於尾。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared from the Tail mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, a meteor as large as Venus appeared from the Tail mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸未，填星守太微垣。

translations.literal: On guiwei Saturn stood guard in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Saturn stood in the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 乙未，祈雨。

translations.literal: On yiwei, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午朔，呂文德依舊侍衛馬軍副都指揮使兼淮西招撫使、知濠州。

translations.literal: On the new moon gengwu of the sixth month, Lü Wende continued as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Horse Army, concurrent Huai West Pacification Commissioner, and Prefect of Hao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, gengwu, Lü Wende retained his posts as deputy commander-in-chief of the Palace Horse Army, concurrent Huai West pacification commissioner, and prefect of Hao.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜禮部進土留夢炎以下四百二十四人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Ministry of Rites presented scholars Liu Mengyan and four hundred twenty-four others were granted passage of the examinations and entry into service in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Ministry of Rites graduates, including Liu Mengyan and four hundred twenty-four others, were granted examination success and official appointment in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔安豐軍策應解壽春圍將士補轉官資有差。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered that the officers and soldiers of Anfeng Army who had assisted in relieving the siege of Shouchun be promoted in rank in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict ordered that the officers and soldiers of Anfeng Army who had helped lift the siege of Shouchun be promoted in rank, with distinctions according to merit.

sentences.zh: 詔：壽春一軍先涉大海，搗山東膠、密諸州有功，今大元兵圍城，能守城不隳，其立功將士皆補轉有差。

translations.literal: An edict stated: The Shouchun army had earlier crossed the sea and raided Jiao and Mi prefectures in Shandong with merit; now with Great Yuan troops besieging the city, they were able to hold the walls without collapse—all meritorious officers and soldiers were to be promoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that the Shouchun garrison had earlier crossed the sea and struck Jiao and Mi in Shandong with success; now, with Great Yuan forces besieging the city, they had held the walls without yielding, and all meritorious officers and soldiers were to be promoted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 乙未，有流星大如太白，出於畢。

translations.literal: On yiwei a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared from the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei a meteor as large as Venus appeared from the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙申，吳潛提舉隆興府玉隆萬壽宮，任便居住。

translations.literal: On bingshen Wu Qian was made Superintendent of the Yulong Longevity Palace in Longxing Prefecture and permitted to reside where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wu Qian was appointed superintendent of the Yulong Longevity Palace in Longxing and allowed to reside where he chose.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，祈雨。

translations.literal: On the new moon jihai of the seventh month of autumn, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the seventh month of autumn, jihai, prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，招收沿淮失業壯丁爲武勝軍，以五千人爲額。

translations.literal: On yimao unemployed strong men along the Huai were recruited into the Wusheng Army, with a quota of five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao unemployed men along the Huai were recruited into the Wusheng Army, with a nominal strength of five thousand.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，盜發永州東安縣，飛虎軍正將吳龍、統制鄭存等討捕有功，詔補轉官資有差。

translations.literal: On xinyou bandits rose in Dong'an County, Yong Prefecture; Captain Wu Long of the Flying Tiger Army, Controller Zheng Cun, and others suppressed them with merit, and an edict ordered promotions in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou bandits broke out in Dong'an County, Yongzhou; Captain Wu Long of the Flying Tiger Army, Controller Zheng Cun, and others suppressed them with success, and an edict ordered promotions according to merit.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔：「故直龍圖閣項安世正學直節，先朝名儒，可特贈集英殿修撰。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict stated: "The late Direct Attendant of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion Xiang Anshi upheld orthodox learning and integrity; a renowned scholar of the former court—he may be specially posthumously granted Compiler of the Hall for Assembling Excellence."
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict declared that the late Xiang Anshi, direct attendant of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, who had upheld orthodox learning and integrity as a renowned scholar of the previous reign, was to be posthumously granted the title compiler of the Hall for Assembling Excellence.

sentences.zh: 」八月壬辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on renchen, the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，右丞相史嵩之以父病謁告，許之，詔范鐘、劉伯正暫領相事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on guimao, Right Chancellor Shi Songzhi requested leave on account of his father's illness; permission was granted, and an edict ordered Fan Zhong and Liu Bozheng temporarily to oversee chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, Right Chancellor Shi Songzhi requested leave because of his father's illness; leave was granted, and Fan Zhong and Liu Bozheng were ordered temporarily to handle chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，史彌忠卒，贈少師，封鄭國公，賜諡文靖。

translations.literal: On jiachen Shi Mizhong died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor, enfeoffed as Duke of Zheng, and given the posthumous title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Shi Mizhong died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor, enfeoffed as Duke of Zheng, and given the posthumous title Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 詔史嵩之起復右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shi Songzhi recalled from mourning to resume as Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Shi Songzhi recalled from mourning to resume as right chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，熒惑、填星合於軫。

translations.literal: On guichou Mars and Saturn conjoined in the Chariot mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Mars and Saturn conjoined in the Chariot mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，京湖制司言，諸將李福等破申州、蔡州西平縣城壁及馬家等砦，詔將士各補官推賞有差。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Jing-Hu commissioner reported that the generals Li Fu and others had taken the walls of Shen Prefecture, Xiping County in Cai Prefecture, and the Ma family stockades; an edict ordered officers and soldiers promoted and rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the Jing-Hu commissioner reported that Generals Li Fu and others had breached the walls of Shenzhou, Xiping County in Caizhou, and the Ma family stockades; an edict ordered promotions and rewards for the officers and soldiers according to merit.

sentences.zh: 己未，將作監徐元傑上疏論史嵩之起復，宜許其舉執政自代。

translations.literal: On jiwei Director of Palace Construction Xu Yuanjie submitted a memorial discussing Shi Songzhi's recall from mourning, stating that he should be permitted to recommend a replacement from among the chief administrators.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Xu Yuanjie, director of palace construction, submitted a memorial on Shi Songzhi's recall from mourning, arguing that he should be allowed to recommend a successor from among the chief administrators.

sentences.zh: 帝不允，遂求去。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not consent, and Xu then requested to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused, whereupon Xu requested to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「經筵賴卿規益，何事引去耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The Classics Lecture Hall relies on your admonitions and benefits—why withdraw for any reason?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The Classics Lecture Hall relies on your counsel—why would you withdraw?"

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，太白犯鬥宿距星。

translations.literal: On guihai the Great White Star transgressed the distance star of the Dipper mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Venus transgressed the distance star of the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雷。

translations.literal: On yichou, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，雷。

translations.literal: On dingmao, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 台臣言嚴州及紹興、蕭山等縣征商煩苛，詔亟罷之。

translations.literal: Censorial officials reported that Yan Prefecture and Shaoxing, Xiaoshan, and other counties imposed onerous and harsh merchant levies; an edict ordered them abolished at once.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials reported that Yanzhou and the counties of Shaoxing and Xiaoshan imposed harsh merchant levies; an edict ordered them abolished immediately.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，詔慶元府守臣敦諭史嵩之赴闕，嵩之控辭，不允。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiaxu, an edict ordered the prefect of Qingyuan to urge Shi Songzhi to proceed to court; Shi submitted a plea of excuse, which was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiaxu, an edict ordered the Qingyuan prefect to urge Shi Songzhi to come to court; Shi pleaded excuse, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，杜范、游似提舉萬壽觀兼侍講。

translations.literal: On renchen Du Fan and You Si were made Superintendents of the Longevity Abbey, concurrent Lecturers-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Du Fan and You Si were appointed superintendents of the Longevity Abbey, with concurrent duties as lecturers-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，詔趣游似、杜范赴闕。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on xinchou, an edict urged You Si and Du Fan to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou, an edict urged You Si and Du Fan to come to court.

sentences.zh: 戊申，雷。

translations.literal: On wushen, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔陳韡、李性傳赴闕。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict ordered Chen Wei and Li Xingchuan to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict ordered Chen Wei and Li Xingchuan to come to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，以范鐘爲左丞相兼樞密使，杜范爲右丞相兼樞密使，游似知樞密院事，劉伯正參知政事兼簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on gengwu, Fan Zhong was made Left Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs; Du Fan Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner; You Si Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Liu Bozheng Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Fan Zhong was appointed left chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs; Du Fan right chancellor and concurrent commissioner; You Si director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Liu Bozheng associate director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔戒飭百官。

translations.literal: An edict admonished all officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict admonished all officials.

sentences.zh: 許右丞相史嵩之終喪。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Shi Songzhi was permitted to complete mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Shi Songzhi was permitted to complete his mourning period.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以趙葵同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zhao Kui was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zhao Kui was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，鄭清之授少保，依舊觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀，仍奉朝請，進封衛國公。

translations.literal: On yihai Zheng Qingzhi was granted Junior Guardian, continuing as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Superintendent of the Liquan Abbey and concurrent Reader-in-Waiting, still attending court audiences, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zheng Qingzhi was granted junior guardian, retaining his posts as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, superintendent of the Liquan Abbey, and concurrent reader-in-waiting, with continued attendance at court, and was advanced in rank to Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁酉朔，詔更新庶政，綏撫中原遺民。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, first month of spring, on dingyou the new moon day, an edict ordered renewal of various policies and pacification of the remnant people of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, dingyou, an edict ordered renewal of government and relief for the remnant people of the Central Plains.

sentences.zh: 丙午，杜範辭免右丞相，不允。

translations.literal: On bingwu Du Fan declined the post of Right Chancellor; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Du Fan declined the post of right chancellor; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雷。

translations.literal: On jiyou, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以李性傳簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On yimao Li Xingchuan was made Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Li Xingchuan was appointed associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，雨土。

translations.literal: On the new moon bingyin of the second month, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, bingyin, there was a fall of dust from the sky.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，復五河，詔呂文德進三秩，羊洪進二秩，余有戰功者推賞，其陣沒人，具姓名贈恤。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Five Rivers were recovered; an edict ordered Lü Wende advanced three ranks, Yang Hong two ranks, and others with battle merit rewarded; those killed in action were to have names submitted for posthumous grants and relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Five Rivers were recovered; an edict ordered Lü Wende promoted three ranks and Yang Hong two ranks, with rewards for others who had distinguished themselves in battle; the names of those killed in action were to be submitted for posthumous honors and relief for their families.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，范鐘等上《玉牒》、《日曆》及孝宗、光宗《御集》、《經武要略》、《寧宗實錄》。

translations.literal: On dingchou Fan Zhong and others presented the Jade Genealogy, Calendar, and the Imperial Collections, Essentials of Military Classics, and Veritable Records of Xiaozong, Guangzong, and Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Fan Zhong and others presented the Jade Genealogy, the Calendar, the imperial collections of Xiaozong and Guangzong, the Essentials of Military Classics, and the Veritable Records of Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On renchen the Great White Star was seen in daylight and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Venus was visible in daylight and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，詔嚴贓吏法，仍命有司舉行彭大雅、程以升、吳淇、徐敏子納賄之罪。

translations.literal: In the third month on gengzi, an edict ordered strict enforcement of the law on corrupt officials and still commanded the relevant offices to prosecute Peng Daya, Cheng Yisheng, Wu Qi, and Xu Minzi for accepting bribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, an edict ordered strict enforcement of laws against corrupt officials and directed the relevant offices to prosecute Peng Daya, Cheng Yisheng, Wu Qi, and Xu Minzi for bribery.

sentences.zh: 准淳熙故事，戒吏貪虐、預借、抑配、重催、取贏。

translations.literal: Following the precedents of the Chunxi era, officials were admonished against greed and cruelty, advance collection, forced apportionment, repeated exaction, and taking surplus profit.
translations.idiomatic: Following Chunxi precedents, officials were admonished against greed and cruelty, advance collection of taxes, forced apportionment, repeated exaction, and taking surplus levies.

sentences.zh: 以緡錢百萬犒淮東師。

translations.literal: One million strings of cash were granted to reward the Huaidong army.
translations.idiomatic: One million strings of cash were granted as rewards for the Huaidong army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，填星犯上相星。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on jiashen, Saturn transgressed the Upper Chancellor star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiashen, Saturn transgressed the Upper Chancellor star.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，杜範薨，贈少傅，諡清獻。

translations.literal: On bingxu Du Fan died; he was posthumously granted Junior Tutor and given the posthumous title Qingxian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Du Fan died; he was posthumously granted junior tutor and given the posthumous title Qingxian.

sentences.zh: 戊子，余玠言權巴州何震之守城死於兵，詔進贈官三秩，一子與下州文學。

translations.literal: On wuzi Yu Jie reported that Acting Prefect of Bazhou He Zhenzhi died defending the city in battle; an edict ordered posthumous advancement of three ranks and one son granted Lower Prefecture Literary Student.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Yu Jie reported that Acting Prefect of Bazhou He Zhenzhi had died defending the city in battle; an edict ordered posthumous promotion of three ranks and appointment of one son as literary student of a lower prefecture.

sentences.zh: 京湖制司言：「鈐轄王雲等襲鄧州鎮平縣靈山，戰順陽鐵撅峪，皆有勞效，野戰數十合，雲等六人被重創死，路鈐于江一軍力戰。

translations.literal: The Jing-Hu commissioner reported: "Controller Wang Yun and others raided Lingshan in Zhenping County, Deng Prefecture, and fought at Tieque Ravine in Shunyang—all with meritorious results; in field battles of several dozen engagements, six including Wang Yun died of severe wounds; Route Controller Yu Jiang's army fought strenuously."
translations.idiomatic: The Jing-Hu commissioner reported that Controller Wang Yun and others had raided Lingshan in Zhenping County, Dengzhou, and fought at Tieque Ravine in Shunyang with considerable success; in dozens of field engagements six men including Wang Yun died of severe wounds, while Route Controller Yu Jiang's army fought with great tenacity.

sentences.zh: 」詔王雲贈三秩，仍官其二子爲承信郎。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wang Yun posthumously advanced three ranks and his two sons appointed Credentialed Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Yun posthumously promoted three ranks and appointed his two sons as credentialed gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 王寬、王立、田秀、董亮、董玉各加贈恤，于江等各轉一官資。

translations.literal: Wang Kuan, Wang Li, Tian Xiu, Dong Liang, and Dong Yu each received additional posthumous grants and relief; Yu Jiang and others each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kuan, Wang Li, Tian Xiu, Dong Liang, and Dong Yu each received additional posthumous honors and relief for their families; Yu Jiang and others each advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 詔李曾伯、余玠、董槐、孟珙、王鑒職事修舉，曾伯、玠升閣職，槐、珙、鑒轉官，並因其任。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Li Zengbo, Yu Jie, Dong Huai, Meng Gong, and Wang Jian had performed their duties well; Zengbo and Jie were elevated in pavilion rank, Huai, Gong, and Jian transferred in rank—all according to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Li Zengbo, Yu Jie, Dong Huai, Meng Gong, and Wang Jian had discharged their duties well; Zengbo and Jie were elevated in pavilion rank, and Huai, Gong, and Jian were promoted in rank, each according to his post.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，呂文福、夏貴上戰功，詔貴官兩轉，文福帶行閣職。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on dingyou, Lü Wenfu and Xia Gui reported battle achievements; an edict ordered Gui advanced two ranks and Wenfu granted acting pavilion office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingyou, Lü Wenfu and Xia Gui reported battle achievements; an edict ordered Xia Gui promoted two ranks and Lü Wenfu granted an acting pavilion appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔：「沿江、湖南、江西、湖廣、兩浙制帥漕司及許浦水軍司，共造輕捷戰船千艘，置遊擊軍壯士三萬人，分備捍禦。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict stated: "The commissioners, transport commissioners, and Xupu Naval Forces Office along the Yangzi, Hunan, Jiangxi, Huguang, and the two Zhe circuits shall jointly build one thousand light swift war vessels and establish thirty thousand raiding troops to be distributed for defense."
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an edict ordered the commissioners, transport commissioners, and Xupu naval office along the Yangzi, Hunan, Jiangxi, Huguang, and the two Zhe circuits jointly to build one thousand light swift war vessels and to establish thirty thousand raiding troops to be distributed for coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，日生赤黃背氣。

translations.literal: On wushen the sun produced red-yellow aureole on its back.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the sun showed a red-yellow corona on its back.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔董槐赴闕。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict ordered Dong Huai to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict ordered Dong Huai to come to court.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，淮東制置使李曾伯辭免煥章閣學士，從之。

translations.literal: On dingsi Huaidong Commissioner Li Zengbo declined the post of Academician of the Huanzhang Pavilion; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Huaidong Commissioner Li Zengbo declined the post of academician of the Huanzhang Pavilion; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，祈雨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on jiashen, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen, prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，工部侍郎徐元傑暴卒，贈四秩。

translations.literal: On bingxu Vice Minister of Works Xu Yuanjie died suddenly; he was posthumously granted four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Vice Minister of Works Xu Yuanjie died suddenly; he was posthumously granted four ranks.

sentences.zh: 置詔獄。

translations.literal: An imperial prison was established.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial prison was established.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the new moon guisi of the seventh month of autumn, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the seventh month of autumn, guisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 旱。

translations.literal: Drought.
translations.idiomatic: There was drought.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，鎮江、常州亢旱，詔監司、守臣及沿江諸郡安集流民。

translations.literal: On xinchou Zhenjiang and Chang Prefectures suffered severe drought; an edict ordered surveillance commissioners, prefects, and prefectures along the Yangzi to settle and gather displaced people.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhenjiang and Changzhou suffered severe drought; an edict ordered surveillance commissioners, prefects, and Yangzi prefectures to settle displaced people.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，祈雨。

translations.literal: On jiachen, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔給徐元傑、劉漢弼官田五百畝、緡錢五千恤其家。

translations.literal: On yimao an edict granted Xu Yuanjie and Liu Hanbi five hundred mu of official fields and five thousand strings of cash to relieve their families.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict granted five hundred mu of official fields and five thousand strings of cash to the families of Xu Yuanjie and Liu Hanbi for their relief.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，京湖制司言總制亢國用師衆戰裕州拐河，戰黑山，戰大神山，皆有勞效。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Jing-Hu commissioner reported that Overall Controller Kang Guoyong led troops in battle at Guai River in Yu Prefecture, at Black Mountain, and at Great Spirit Mountain—all with meritorious results.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Jing-Hu commissioner reported that Overall Controller Kang Guoyong had led troops in battle at Guai River in Yuzhou, at Black Mountain, and at Great Spirit Mountain, all with considerable success.

sentences.zh: 詔國用官兩轉，李山等四十七人官一轉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Guoyong advanced two ranks and forty-seven including Li Shan one rank each.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Guoyong promoted two ranks and forty-seven others, including Li Shan, promoted one rank each.

sentences.zh: 呂文德言與大元兵戰五河隘口，又戰於濠州，大元兵還。

translations.literal: Lü Wende reported fighting Great Yuan troops at the Five Rivers pass and again at Hao Prefecture; the Great Yuan troops withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wende reported fighting Great Yuan forces at the Five Rivers pass and again at Hao; the Great Yuan forces withdrew.

sentences.zh: 詔文德屯駐諸軍戰守將士，推恩有差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered rewards in varying degrees for the officers and soldiers of Lü Wende's encamped forces who had fought and defended.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered rewards for the officers and soldiers under Lü Wende's command who had fought and held their positions, with distinctions according to merit.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，范鐘再乞歸田，不允。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on gengchen, Fan Zhong again requested to retire to his fields; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, Fan Zhong again asked to retire to his estates; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，京湖制置司言：「劉整等率精銳，以雲梯四面登鎮平縣城，入城巷戰，焚城中倉庫、糗糧、器甲，路將武勝等四人死之；

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiachen the Jing-Hu Pacification Office reported: "Liu Zheng and others led elite troops, scaling the walls of Zhenping County on four sides with cloud ladders, fighting in the streets within the city, burning the granaries, provisions, and armor in the city; Route Generals Wusheng and four others died;"
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiachen, the Jing-Hu Pacification Office reported that Liu Zheng and others had led elite troops, scaling the walls of Zhenping County on four sides with siege ladders, fighting street by street within the city and burning its granaries, provisions, and armor; Route Generals Wusheng and four others were killed;

sentences.zh: 略廣陽，焚列屯、砦柵、廬舍凡二十餘所；

translations.literal: "they raided Guangyang, burning more than twenty encampments, stockades, palisades, and dwellings in succession;"
translations.idiomatic: they raided Guangyang, burning more than twenty encampments, stockades, palisades, and dwellings;

sentences.zh: 還抵靈山，又力戰有功。

translations.literal: "returning to Lingshan, they again fought strenuously with merit."
translations.idiomatic: and on returning to Lingshan fought again with considerable success.

sentences.zh: 」詔整官兩轉，同行蔡貴等二百二十人各官一轉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zheng advanced two ranks and two hundred twenty including Cai Gui who accompanied him one rank each.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zheng promoted two ranks and two hundred twenty others who had accompanied him, including Cai Gui, promoted one rank each.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀明堂，奉太祖、太宗、寧宗並侑。

translations.literal: On xinhai the Bright Hall was sacrificed to, with Taizu, Taizong, and Ningzong all enshrined as associates.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall, with Taizu, Taizong, and Ningzong all enshrined as associates.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，鄭清之乞歸田，不允。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on yiwei, Zheng Qingzhi requested to retire to his fields; the request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on yiwei, Zheng Qingzhi asked to retire to his estates; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔師彌典伺屬籍，職事修舉，授太傅，加食邑，依前判大宗正事、嗣秀王。

translations.literal: On bingshen an edict stated that Shi Midian had supervised the imperial genealogy and performed his duties well; he was granted Grand Preceptor, increased fief income, and continued as Director of the Great Imperial Clan and Heir Apparent Prince of Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict noted that Shi Midian had supervised the imperial genealogy and discharged his duties well; he was granted grand preceptor, with increased fief income, and retained his posts as director of the Great Imperial Clan and heir apparent prince of Xiu.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔：大元兵入蜀，權成都府馮有碩、權漢州王驤、權成都縣楊兌、權資州劉永、權潼川府魏靄死於官守，其各贈官三轉，仍官其一子。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict stated: Great Yuan troops entered Shu; Acting Prefect of Chengdu Feng Youshuo, Acting Prefect of Han Wang Qiang, Acting Magistrate of Chengdu Yang Dui, Acting Prefect of Zi Liu Yong, and Acting Prefect of Tongchuan Wei Ai died at their posts—each was posthumously granted three ranks and one son appointed to office.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict noted that after Great Yuan forces entered Shu, Acting Prefect of Chengdu Feng Youshuo, Acting Prefect of Han Wang Qiang, Acting Magistrate of Chengdu Yang Dui, Acting Prefect of Zi Liu Yong, and Acting Prefect of Tongchuan Wei Ai had died at their posts; each was posthumously promoted three ranks and one son was appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔將領關貴、統制白傅才率衆復洋州，還遇大元兵交戰，將士百五十三人皆陣沒，已祔饗閔忠廟，贍恤其家。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict stated that the generals Guan Gui and Controller Bai Fucai led troops to recover Yang Prefecture; on the return they encountered Great Yuan troops in battle, and one hundred fifty-three officers and soldiers all died in action—they had been enshrined at the Temple of Loyalty to the Suffering, and their families were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict noted that Generals Guan Gui and Controller Bai Fucai had led troops to recover Yangzhou; on the return they met Great Yuan forces in battle, and one hundred fifty-three officers and soldiers were all killed in action; they had been enshrined at the Temple of Loyalty to the Suffering, and their families were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 關貴、白傅才各贈承節郎，官其一子進勇副尉。

translations.literal: Guan Gui and Bai Fucai were each posthumously granted Gentleman for Upholding Integrity, and one son of each appointed Vice Warden for Advancing Courage.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Gui and Bai Fucai were each posthumously granted gentleman for upholding integrity, and one son of each was appointed vice warden for advancing courage.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔壽春守臣劉雄飛等以大元兵圍城捍禦有功，雄飛及呂文福、林子崈等十一人各官三轉，劉用等補轉官資有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on jiaxu an edict stated that the defender of Shouchun Liu Xiongfei and others had merit in defending against the Great Yuan siege; Xiongfei, Lü Wenfu, Lin Zicong, and eleven others each advanced three ranks, and Liu Yong and others promoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, an edict noted that the defender of Shouchun Liu Xiongfei and others had distinguished themselves in holding the city against the Great Yuan siege; Xiongfei, Lü Wenfu, Lin Zicong, and eleven others were each promoted three ranks, and Liu Yong and others were promoted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以遊似爲右丞相兼樞密使，鄭清之爲少師、奉國軍節度使，依前醴泉觀使兼侍讀，仍奉朝請，賜玉帶及賜第行在。

translations.literal: On jimao You Si was made Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs; Zheng Qingzhi Junior Preceptor and Military Commissioner of Fengguo Army, continuing as Superintendent of Liquan Abbey and concurrent Reader-in-Waiting, still attending court audiences, granted jade belt and a residence in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao You Si was appointed right chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs; Zheng Qingzhi was granted junior preceptor and military commissioner of the Fengguo Army, retaining his posts as superintendent of the Liquan Abbey and concurrent reader-in-waiting, with continued attendance at court, and was granted a jade belt and a residence in the capital.

sentences.zh: 兄與歡換授安德軍節度使、開府儀同三司、萬壽觀使，仍奉朝請；

translations.literal: His elder brother You Huan was transferred to Military Commissioner of Ande Army, Grand Master with Opening Office and Equal to the Three Excellencies, Superintendent of Longevity Abbey, still attending court audiences;
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother You Huan was transferred to military commissioner of the Ande Army, grand master with opening office equal to the three excellencies, and superintendent of the Longevity Abbey, with continued attendance at court;

sentences.zh: 弟嗣沂王貴謙、嗣榮王與芮並加授少保。

translations.literal: his younger brothers the Heir Apparent Prince of Yi Gui Qian and the Heir Apparent Prince of Rong You Rui were both additionally granted Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: and his younger brothers, the heir apparent princes of Yi and Rong, Gui Qian and You Rui, were both additionally granted junior guardian.

sentences.zh: 以趙葵知樞密院事兼參知政事，李性傳同知樞密院事，陳韡兼參知政事。

translations.literal: Zhao Kui was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Li Xingchuan Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Chen Wei concurrent Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kui was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Li Xingchuan vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Chen Wei concurrent associate director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太史奏來歲正旦日當食，詔以是月二十一日避殿減膳，命百司講行闕政，凡可以消弭災變者，直言毋隱。

translations.literal: On renwu the Grand Astrologer reported that on New Year's Day of the coming year there would be an eclipse; an edict ordered on the twenty-first day of this month withdrawal from the hall and reduced meals, commanding all offices to deliberate on neglected policies—whatever could dispel calamities and transformations, speak frankly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the grand astrologer reported that the coming New Year's Day would see a solar eclipse; an edict ordered that on the twenty-first of this month the court withdraw from the main hall and reduce meals, and directed all offices to address neglected policies, with frank counsel on anything that might avert calamity.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, first month of spring, on xinmao the new moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, xinmao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 置國用所，命趙與𥲅爲提領官。

translations.literal: The Office of State Revenue was established, and Zhao Yuyu was appointed Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: The Office of State Revenue was established, with Zhao Yuyu appointed as its superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，范鐘再乞歸田裏，詔官三轉，觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the second month on wuchen, Fan Zhong again requested to return to his rural estate; an edict advanced him three ranks, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Superintendent of Liquan Abbey and concurrent Reader-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen, Fan Zhong again asked to retire to his home district; an edict promoted him three ranks and granted him grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, superintendent of the Liquan Abbey, and concurrent reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 己巳，范鐘再辭，詔提舉洞霄宮，任便居住。

translations.literal: On jisi Fan Zhong declined again; an edict made him Superintendent of the Cavern of Heaven Abbey and permitted to reside where he wished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Fan Zhong declined again; an edict appointed him superintendent of the Cavern of Heaven Abbey and allowed him to reside where he chose.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以劉雄飛知壽春府、節制屯田軍馬。

translations.literal: On gengwu Liu Xiongfei was made Prefect of Shouchun and Controller of Military Colony Troops and Horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Liu Xiongfei was appointed prefect of Shouchun and controller of military colony troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，日暈周匝，珥氣。

translations.literal: In the third month on guisi, the sun was encircled by a halo, with pendant aureole.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, the sun was surrounded by a complete halo with pendant aureole.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on xinyou, the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinyou, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太陰犯太白。

translations.literal: On renxu the Moon transgressed the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Moon transgressed Venus.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以丘嶽兼兩淮屯田副使，賈似道兼蘄、黃屯田副使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Qiu Yue was made concurrent Deputy Commissioner of Military Colonies for the Two Huai circuits; Jia Sidao concurrent Deputy Commissioner for Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Qiu Yue was appointed concurrent deputy commissioner of military colonies for the Two Huai circuits, and Jia Sidao concurrent deputy commissioner for Qi and Huang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On dingchou the sun was encircled by a halo.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the sun was surrounded by a complete halo.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔朱熹門人胡安之、呂燾、蔡模並迪功郎、本州州學教授。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict ordered Zhu Xi's disciples Hu Anzhi, Lü Yan, and Cai Mo all granted Aspirant Merit Gentleman and Professors of the Prefectural School of their native prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict appointed Zhu Xi's disciples Hu Anzhi, Lü Yan, and Cai Mo as aspirant merit gentlemen and professors of their native prefectural schools.

sentences.zh: 給劄錄其著述，並條具所欲言者以聞。

translations.literal: Letters were issued to record their writings, and they were to submit in detail whatever they wished to say for report.
translations.idiomatic: Letters were issued to record their writings, and they were to submit in detail whatever they wished to report to the throne.

sentences.zh: 閏四月辛卯，李曾伯以台諫論，詔落職予祠，尋罷祠祿。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month on xinmao, Li Zengbo on censorial remonstrance was ordered stripped of office and granted a temple post; soon his temple stipend was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on xinmao, after censorial remonstrance against Li Zengbo, an edict stripped him of office and granted him a temple post; soon his temple stipend was abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，呂文德言：「今春北兵攻兩淮，統制汪懷忠等逆戰趙家園，拔還俘獲人民；

translations.literal: On wuxu Lü Wende reported: "This spring northern troops attacked the Two Huai circuits; Controller Wang Huaizhong and others met them in battle at Zhao Family Garden and recovered captured people;"
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Lü Wende reported that that spring northern forces had attacked the Two Huai circuits, and that Controller Wang Huaizhong and others had met them at Zhao Family Garden and recovered captives;

sentences.zh: 路鈐夏貴，知州王成、倪政等帥舟師援安豐軍，所至數戰，將士陣亡者衆。

translations.literal: "Route Controller Xia Gui, Prefects Wang Cheng and Ni Zheng, and others led naval forces to relieve Anfeng Army; wherever they went they fought repeatedly, and many officers and soldiers died in action."
translations.idiomatic: Route Controller Xia Gui, Prefects Wang Cheng and Ni Zheng, and others had led naval forces to relieve Anfeng Army, fighting repeatedly along the way, with many officers and soldiers killed in action.

sentences.zh: 」詔倪政贈官三轉，官一子承信郎；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ni Zheng posthumously advanced three ranks and one son appointed Credentialed Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Ni Zheng posthumously promoted three ranks and one son appointed credentialed gentleman;

sentences.zh: 許通、夏珪、孫才江德仙各贈官兩轉，官其一子下班祗應，給緡錢恤其家；

translations.literal: Xu Tong, Xia Gui, Sun Cai, and Jiang Dexian each posthumously advanced two ranks, one son of each appointed Lower Class Attendant, and strings of cash granted to relieve their families;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tong, Xia Gui, Sun Cai, and Jiang Dexian were each posthumously promoted two ranks, with one son of each appointed lower-class attendant and strings of cash granted to their families;

sentences.zh: 余立功將士恩賞有差。

translations.literal: the remaining meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: and the remaining meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，月暈五重。

translations.literal: On xinchou the moon had five halos.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the moon showed five halos.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，余玠言：北兵分四道入蜀，將士捍禦有功者，輒以便宜推賞，具立功等第補轉官資以聞。

translations.literal: On guimao Yu Jie reported: Northern troops entered Shu by four routes; wherever officers and soldiers had merit in defense, he had promptly rewarded them as circumstances allowed and submitted merit ranks for promotion for report.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yu Jie reported that northern forces had entered Shu by four routes; wherever officers and soldiers had distinguished themselves in defense, he had promptly rewarded them as circumstances allowed and would submit merit ranks for promotion.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved the request.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，詔賈似道措置淮西山砦城築。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on gengshen an edict ordered Jia Sidao to arrange the construction of stockade cities in the western mountains of Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengshen, an edict ordered Jia Sidao to arrange construction of stockade fortifications in the western Huai mountains.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白犯權星。

translations.literal: On renxu the Great White Star transgressed the Power star.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Venus transgressed the Power star.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔諸鎮募兵、造舟、置馬，帥臣其務獎激將士，以嚴邊防。

translations.literal: On jimao an edict ordered all garrisons to recruit troops, build vessels, and procure horses; commanders were to strive to encourage officers and soldiers and tighten border defense.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict ordered all garrisons to recruit troops, build vessels, and procure horses, and directed commanders to encourage their officers and soldiers and strengthen border defense.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，泉州歲饑，其民謝應瑞非因有司勸分，自出私錢四十余萬，糴米以振鄉井，所全活甚衆。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on renxu, Quan Prefecture suffered famine that year; the commoner Xie Yingrui, not because officials urged sharing, himself disbursed more than four hundred thousand in private funds to purchase rice to relieve his township, saving very many lives.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renxu, Quanzhou suffered famine that year; the commoner Xie Yingrui, without being urged by officials to share grain, himself disbursed more than four hundred thousand in private funds to buy rice and relieve his township, saving a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 詔補進義校尉。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him promoted to Advanced Righteousness Captain.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted him to advanced righteousness captain.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯鬥。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Moon transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Moon transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 己巳，呂文德言：「北兵圍壽春城，州師至黃家穴，總管孫琦、呂文信、夏貴等戰龍堽有功。

translations.literal: On jisi Lü Wende reported: "Northern troops besieged Shouchun city; the prefectural army reached Huang Family Cave; Overall Controllers Sun Qi, Lü Wenxin, Xia Gui, and others fought at Longgang with merit."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Lü Wende reported that northern forces had besieged Shouchun, that the prefectural army had reached Huang Family Cave, and that Overall Controllers Sun Qi, Lü Wenxin, Xia Gui, and others had fought at Longgang with considerable success.

sentences.zh: 」詔文德官一轉，餘依等第轉補；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wende advanced one rank, the rest promoted according to merit rank;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wende promoted one rank and the others promoted according to merit;

sentences.zh: 其陣沒董先等二十二人、傷者四百三十七人，贈恤恩賞有差。

translations.literal: of those killed in action including Dong Xian, twenty-two persons, and wounded, four hundred thirty-seven, posthumous grants, relief, and rewards were in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: for the twenty-two killed in action, including Dong Xian, and four hundred thirty-seven wounded, posthumous honors, relief, and rewards were granted according to merit.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有流星出自室，大如太白。

translations.literal: On guiyou a meteor issued from the Encampment mansion, as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a meteor issued from the Encampment mansion, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on xinmao the Moon transgressed the Chamber mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the Moon transgressed the Chamber mansion.

sentences.zh: 己酉，賜文士劉克莊進士出身，以爲秘書少監兼國史院編修官、實錄院檢討官。

translations.literal: On jiyou the literary scholar Liu Kezhuang was granted jinshi entry and made Vice Director of the Secretariat, concurrent Compiler of the National History Institute and Reviser of the Veritable Records Institute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the literary scholar Liu Kezhuang was granted jinshi standing and appointed vice director of the Secretariat, concurrent compiler of the National History Institute and reviser of the Veritable Records Institute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On renzi the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以劉克莊兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: On guichou Liu Kezhuang was made concurrent Lecturer of the Hall for Exalting Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liu Kezhuang was appointed concurrent lecturer of the Hall for Exalting Governance.

sentences.zh: 樞密院言：「前知普州何叔丁、簽書判官楊仁舉，淳祐元年冬北兵攻城，兩家二十余人死于難，叔丁孫嗣祖、仁舉幼子肖翁被俘逃歸。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Former Prefect of Pu Prefecture He Shuding and Associate Signing Administrator Yang Renju—in the winter of the first year of Chunyou northern troops attacked the city; more than twenty from both families died in the calamity; Shuding's grandson Sizu and Renju's young son Xiao Weng were captured and escaped back."
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Military Affairs reported that the former prefect of Puzhou, He Shuding, and associate signing administrator Yang Renju, when northern forces attacked the city in the winter of the first year of Chunyou, had lost more than twenty members of both families in the calamity; Shuding's grandson Sizu and Renju's young son Xiao Weng had been captured but escaped and returned.

sentences.zh: 」詔叔丁等贈官恤後有差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shuding and others posthumously granted office and relief for survivors in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered posthumous honors for Shuding and others and relief for their survivors according to merit.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，有流星出於鬥，大如太白。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on jiazi a meteor issued from the Dipper, as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, a meteor issued from the Dipper mansion, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以賈似道爲敷文閣直學士、京湖制置使、知江陵府兼夔路策應使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Jia Sidao was made Direct Academician of the Fuwen Pavilion, Jing-Hu Pacification Commissioner, Prefect of Jiangling, and concurrent Coordinator for the Kuizhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Jia Sidao was appointed direct academician of the Fuwen Pavilion, Jing-Hu pacification commissioner, prefect of Jiangling, and concurrent coordinator for the Kuizhou route.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: The Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，孟珙薨，贈少師。

translations.literal: On guiyou Meng Gong died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Meng Gong died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己丑，少保、嗣榮王與芮之子賜名孟啟，授貴州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jichou, the son of Junior Guardian and Heir Apparent Prince of Rong You Rui was granted the name Meng Qi and appointed Prefect of Gui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jichou, the son of Junior Guardian and Heir Apparent Prince of Rong You Rui was granted the name Meng Qi and appointed prefect of Gui.

sentences.zh: 乙未，填星、歲星、熒惑合於亢。

translations.literal: On yiwei Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars conjoined in the Neck mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars conjoined in the Neck mansion.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太白入氐。

translations.literal: On jiyou the Great White Star entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Venus entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，歲星入氐。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on guihai Jupiter entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guihai, Jupiter entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，右丞相游似五請歸田裏，詔不允。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Right Chancellor You Si five times requested to return to his rural estate; the edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Right Chancellor You Si five times asked to retire to his home district; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔：「北兵入蜀，前四川制置使陳隆之闔家數百口罹害，死不易節，其特賜徽猷閣待制，官其二子，賜諡立廟。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict stated: "Northern troops entered Shu; former Sichuan Pacification Commissioner Chen Longzhi's entire household of several hundred suffered calamity; he died without changing his integrity—he is specially granted Attendant Gentleman of the Huiyao Pavilion, his two sons appointed to office, posthumous title granted and a temple established."
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict noted that after northern forces entered Shu, the former Sichuan pacification commissioner Chen Longzhi and his entire household of several hundred had perished without yielding their integrity; he was specially granted attendant gentleman of the Huiyao Pavilion, his two sons were appointed to office, and he was given a posthumous title with a temple established in his honor.

sentences.zh: 死事史季儉、楊戡子各賜官兩轉，官一子。

translations.literal: Those who died in service, Shi Jijian and Yang Kanzi, each had two ranks granted and one son appointed to office.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jijian and Yang Kanzi, who had died in service, were each posthumously promoted two ranks, with one son of each appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 」十二月乙未，詔史嵩之依所乞守金紫光祿大夫、觀文殿大學士、永國公致仕。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on yiwei an edict ordered Shi Songzhi, as he had requested, to retire as Guardian of the Golden Purple and Luminous Grandee, Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, and Duke of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei, an edict granted Shi Songzhi retirement, as he had requested, as guardian of the golden purple and luminous grandee, grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, and Duke of Yong.

sentences.zh: 台諫論史嵩之無父無君，丑聲穢行，律以無將之法，罪有餘誅，乞寢宮祠，削官遠竄。

translations.literal: Censorial remonstrance argued that Shi Songzhi was without father and without ruler, of foul reputation and vile conduct; judged by the law against those without a commander, his crime deserved execution beyond measure—they begged to suspend his palace temple post, strip his office, and banish him far away.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial remonstrance argued that Shi Songzhi had been faithless to father and sovereign alike, with a foul reputation and vile conduct; judged by the law against disloyal subjects, his crimes deserved death—they requested suspension of his palace temple post, stripping of his office, and banishment to a distant place.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月乙卯朔，詔：「間者絀逐非才，收召衆正，史嵩之已令致事，示不復用。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, first month of spring, on yimao the new moon day, an edict stated: "Recently the unworthy were dismissed and the upright gathered; Shi Songzhi has been ordered to retire, showing he will not be used again."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the new moon of the first month of spring, yimao, an edict declared that the unworthy had recently been dismissed and the upright recalled; Shi Songzhi had been ordered to retire, showing that he would not be employed again.

sentences.zh: 咨爾二三大臣，其一乃心，務舉實政，以輯寧我邦家。

translations.literal: "I consult you great ministers—unite your hearts, strive to enact real policies, and thereby bring peace to our state and family."
translations.idiomatic: I charge you, my great ministers, to unite your hearts, strive to enact real policies, and thereby bring peace to our state and house.

sentences.zh: 若辭浮於實，玩愒歲月，朕何賴焉。

translations.literal: "If words exceed deeds and you idle away the months, on whom can I rely?"
translations.idiomatic: If your words exceed your deeds and you idle away the months, on whom can I rely?

sentences.zh: 」建資善堂，授孟啟宜州觀察使，就內小學。

translations.literal: The Hall for Nurturing Goodness was established; Meng Qi was granted Military Commissioner of Yi Prefecture and entered the inner elementary school.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall for Nurturing Goodness was established; Meng Qi was granted military commissioner of Yizhou and entered the inner elementary school.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，詔：「淮安主簿周子鎔，久俘於北，數遣蠟書諜報邊事，今遂生還，可改朝奉郎，優與升擢。

translations.literal: In the second month on gengyin an edict stated: "Huai'an Registrar Zhou Zirong, long captive in the north, repeatedly sent wax-sealed secret reports on border affairs; now he has returned alive—he may be changed to Court Gentleman for Attending Sacrifice and favorably promoted."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, an edict noted that Huai'an registrar Zhou Zirong, long held captive in the north, had repeatedly sent wax-sealed intelligence on border affairs and had now returned alive; he was to be promoted to court gentleman for attending sacrifice with favorable advancement.

sentences.zh: 」己亥，貴妃賈氏薨。

translations.literal: On jihai the Honored Consort of the Jia clan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Honored Consort Jia died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，日暈周匝。

translations.literal: On wushen the sun was encircled by a halo.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the sun was surrounded by a complete halo.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔改潛邸爲龍翔宮。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict ordered the Hidden Residence changed to the Dragon Soaring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict renamed the Hidden Residence as the Dragon Soaring Palace.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，祈雨。

translations.literal: In the third month on gengwu, prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengwu, prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，填星犯亢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on dinghai, Saturn transgressed the Neck mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dinghai, Saturn transgressed the Neck mansion.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以王伯大簽書樞密院事，吳潛同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On gengzi Wang Boda was made Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wu Qian Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wang Boda was appointed associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and Wu Qian associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以鄭清之爲太傅、右丞相兼樞密使，封越國公；

translations.literal: On xinchou Zheng Qingzhi was made Grand Preceptor, Right Chancellor, and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs, enfeoffed as Duke of Yue;
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zheng Qingzhi was appointed grand preceptor, right chancellor, and concurrent commissioner of military affairs, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yue;

sentences.zh: 游似罷爲觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀；

translations.literal: You Si was dismissed to Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Superintendent of Liquan Abbey, and concurrent Reader-in-Waiting;
translations.idiomatic: You Si was dismissed to grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, superintendent of the Liquan Abbey, and concurrent reader-in-waiting;

sentences.zh: 趙葵爲樞密使兼參知政事，督視江淮、京西、湖北軍馬；

translations.literal: Zhao Kui was made Commissioner of Military Affairs and concurrent Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs, Superintendent of Jiang-Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei military forces;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kui was appointed commissioner of military affairs and concurrent associate director of the Department of State Affairs, with superintendence over Jiang-Huai, Jingxi, and Hubei forces;

sentences.zh: 陳韡知樞密院事、湖南安撫大使、知潭州。

translations.literal: Chen Wei was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Grand Ambassador for Hunan Pacification, and Prefect of Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Wei was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, grand ambassador for Hunan pacification, and prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，趙葵兼知建康府、行宮留守、江東安撫使，應軍行調度並聽便宜行事；

translations.literal: On jiachen Zhao Kui was additionally made Prefect of Jiankang, Mobile Court Defender, and Jiangdong Pacification Commissioner; all military movements and arrangements on campaign were to heed his discretionary action;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhao Kui was additionally appointed prefect of Jiankang, mobile court defender, and Jiangdong pacification commissioner, with authority to act at discretion in all military movements and arrangements on campaign;

sentences.zh: 趙希塈禮部尚書、督視行府參贊軍事。

translations.literal: Zhao Xijiong was Minister of Rites and Assistant in Military Affairs for the Superintendent's Mobile Office.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xijiong was appointed minister of rites and assistant in military affairs for the superintendent's mobile office.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，出緡錢千萬、銀十五萬兩、祠牒千、絹萬，並戶部銀五千萬兩，付督視行府趙葵調用。

translations.literal: On gengxu ten million strings of cash, one hundred fifty thousand taels of silver, one thousand temple certificates, ten thousand bolts of silk, and fifty million taels of Ministry of Revenue silver were disbursed for the use of Superintendent Zhao Kui's mobile office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu ten million strings of cash, one hundred fifty thousand taels of silver, one thousand temple certificates, ten thousand bolts of silk, and fifty million taels of Ministry of Revenue silver were disbursed for the use of Superintendent Zhao Kui's mobile office.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，寧淮軍統制張忠戍浮山，手搏北將，俱溺水死，贈武略大夫，官一子承信郎，緡錢五千給其家。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jiayin, Controller Zhang Zhong of the Ning-Huai Army garrisoned Fushan, grappled hand to hand with a northern general, and both drowned; he was posthumously granted Grand Master of Martial Strategy, one son appointed Credentialed Gentleman, and five thousand strings granted to his family.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin, Controller Zhang Zhong of the Ning-Huai Army, garrisoning Fushan, grappled hand to hand with a northern general and both drowned; he was posthumously granted grand master of martial strategy, one son was appointed credentialed gentleman, and five thousand strings were granted to his family.

sentences.zh: 祈雨。

translations.literal: Prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: Prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以吳潛兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On renshen Wu Qian was made Acting Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wu Qian was appointed acting associate director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，御集英殿策士，詔求直言弭旱。

translations.literal: On yihai the Emperor held examinations in the Hall for Assembling Excellence and ordered frank speech to quell the drought.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor held examinations in the Hall for Assembling Excellence and called for frank counsel to end the drought.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，賜禮部進士張淵微以下五百二十七人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on guisi, the Ministry of Rites jinshi Zhang Yuanwei and five hundred twenty-seven others were granted passage of the examinations and entry into service in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guisi, Ministry of Rites jinshi Zhang Yuanwei and five hundred twenty-seven others were granted examination success and official appointment in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以旱，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On bingshen, on account of drought, the court withdrew from the hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, on account of drought, the court withdrew from the main hall and reduced meals.

sentences.zh: 詔中外臣僚士民直陳過失，毋有所諱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered court and common officials and the people to state faults directly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials and commoners alike to state faults frankly without concealment.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔：「旱勢未釋，兩淮、襄、蜀及江、閩內地，曾經兵州縣，遣骼暴露，感傷和氣，所屬有司收瘞之。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict stated: "The drought has not yet abated; in the Two Huai circuits, Xiang, Shu, and the interior of Jiang and Min, in prefectures and counties that have seen warfare, exposed bones lie about, injuring harmonious qi—the relevant offices shall gather and bury them."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict noted that the drought had not yet abated; in the Two Huai circuits, Xiang, Shu, and the interior of Jiang and Min, in prefectures and counties that had seen warfare, exposed bones lay about, disturbing harmonious qi, and the relevant offices were ordered to gather and bury them.

sentences.zh: 」秋七月己未，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on jiwei the Moon transgressed the Heart mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, the Moon transgressed the Heart mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，吳潛罷。

translations.literal: On yichou Wu Qian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wu Qian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以別之傑參知政事，鄭寀同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingmao Bie Zhijie was made Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zheng Cai Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Bie Zhijie was appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs, and Zheng Cai associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，吳潛依舊端明殿學士、知福州、福建安撫使。

translations.literal: On jimao Wu Qian continued as Academician of the Duanming Hall, Prefect of Fuzhou, and Fujian Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wu Qian retained his posts as academician of the Duanming Hall, prefect of Fuzhou, and Fujian pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，有流星出於室。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on bingchen a meteor issued from the Encampment mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, a meteor issued from the Encampment mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，雷。

translations.literal: On guiyou, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on xinsi the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinsi, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 己酉，台臣言添差、抽差、攝局、須入、奏辟、改任、薦舉、借補、曠職、匿過十弊。

translations.literal: On jiyou censorial officials reported ten abuses: supernumerary appointment, drawn appointment, acting office, required entry, memorial recommendation, transfer of post, recommendation, borrowed supplement, dereliction of duty, and concealment of faults.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou censorial officials reported ten abuses in official appointment: supernumerary posts, drawn appointments, acting offices, required entry, memorial recommendations, transfer of posts, recommendations, borrowed supplements, dereliction of duty, and concealment of faults.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，詔：「茶陵知縣事黃端卿爲郴寇所害，進官三秩，官一子將仕郎，立廟衡州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on dingsi an edict stated: "Magistrate of Chaling Huang Duanqing was killed by Chen bandits; advance three ranks, appoint one son Gentleman for Initial Service, establish a temple in Heng Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, an edict noted that Huang Duanqing, magistrate of Chaling, had been killed by Chen bandits; he was to be posthumously promoted three ranks, one son appointed gentleman for initial service, and a temple established in Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 」十二月辛巳，李鳴復卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on xinsi Li Mingfu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, Li Mingfu died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔：「太學生程九萬自北脫身來歸，且條上邊事，賜迪功郎。」

translations.literal: On renchen an edict stated: "Imperial University student Cheng Jiuwan escaped from the north and returned, and submitted border affairs in detail—grant Aspirant Merit Gentleman."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict noted that Imperial University student Cheng Jiuwan had escaped from the north and returned, submitted border affairs in detail, and was granted aspirant merit gentleman.

sentences.zh: 八年春二月丁亥，趙葵言呂文德洎諸將解泗州之圍有功，詔補轉推賞有差。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, second month of spring on dinghai, Zhao Kui reported that Lü Wende and the generals had merit in relieving the siege of Sizhou; an edict ordered promotions and rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, in the second month of spring, on dinghai, Zhao Kui reported that Lü Wende and his generals had distinguished themselves in lifting the siege of Sizhou; an edict ordered promotions and rewards according to merit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太陰生黃白暈。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Moon produced yellow-white halo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Moon showed a yellow-white halo.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雨雹。

translations.literal: On guisi, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi hail fell.

sentences.zh: 乙未，福州福安縣民羅母年過百歲，特封孺人，復其家。

translations.literal: On yiwei the commoner Mother Luo of Fu'an County, Fuzhou, was over one hundred years old; she was specially enfeoffed as Lady and her household exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Mother Luo, a commoner of Fu'an County in Fuzhou, who was over one hundred years old, was specially granted the title lady and her household exempted from levies.

sentences.zh: 敕有司歲時存問，以厚風化。

translations.literal: An imperial command ordered the relevant offices to inquire after her annually so as to enrich custom and transformation.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial command directed the relevant offices to inquire after her annually so as to encourage exemplary conduct.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，趙葵表：「招、泗斷橋，將士用命，兵退。

translations.literal: On xinchou Zhao Kui memorialized: "At Zhao and Si Broken Bridge the officers and soldiers obeyed orders and the enemy withdrew."
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhao Kui memorialized that at Zhao and Si Broken Bridge the officers and soldiers had obeyed orders and the enemy had withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 陳奕、譚涓玉、王成等戰渦河、龜山有勞，聞其步兵多山東人，遂調史用政等襲膠州，復襲高密縣，以牽制侵淮之師。

translations.literal: Chen Yi, Tan Juanyu, Wang Cheng, and others fought at Wo River and Guishan with merit; hearing that their infantry were mostly Shandong men, Shi Yongzheng and others were dispatched to raid Jiao Prefecture and again raid Gaomi County to pin down troops invading Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yi, Tan Juanyu, Wang Cheng, and others had fought at Wo River and Guishan with success; learning that the enemy infantry were mostly from Shandong, Shi Yongzheng and others were dispatched to raid Jiaozhou and then Gaomi County to pin down forces invading the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 」詔趣上立功將士等第、姓名推賞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered prompt submission of merit ranks and names of meritorious officers and soldiers for reward.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered prompt submission of merit ranks and names of meritorious officers and soldiers for reward.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On yichou, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou hail fell.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔：「先鋒軍統制田智潤泗州潮河壩之戰，父子俱死于兵，贈智潤修武郎，子承節郎，更官其一子承信郎，給緡錢五千恤其家。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict stated: "Vanguard Army Controller Tian Zhirun—in the battle at Sizhou Chao River Dam, father and son both died in battle; grant Zhirun posthumously Gentleman for Cultivating Martiality, his son Gentleman for Upholding Integrity, additionally appoint one son Credentialed Gentleman, grant five thousand strings to relieve the family."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict noted that Vanguard Army Controller Tian Zhirun and his son had both been killed at the battle at Sizhou Chao River Dam; Zhirun was posthumously granted gentleman for cultivating martiality, his son gentleman for upholding integrity, one additional son appointed credentialed gentleman, and five thousand strings granted to his family.

sentences.zh: 」夏四月庚辰，詔淮東制置司於泗州立廟，祠夏皋及張忠、田智潤父子，賜額以旌忠節。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on gengchen an edict ordered the Huaidong Pacification Office to establish a temple at Sizhou to sacrifice to Xia Gao and Zhang Zhong and Tian Zhirun father and son, granting a plaque title to honor loyal integrity.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengchen, an edict ordered the Huaidong Pacification Office to establish a temple at Sizhou to honor Xia Gao, Zhang Zhong, and Tian Zhirun and his son, with an inscribed plaque title to commemorate their loyal service.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，贈朝奉郎程克己妻王氏同沒王事，進贈安人。

translations.literal: On dinghai Lady Wang, wife of the posthumously granted Court Gentleman for Attending Sacrifice Cheng Keji, who died together in royal service, was advanced to Lady.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Lady Wang, wife of Cheng Keji, posthumously granted court gentleman for attending sacrifice, who had died together in royal service, was advanced to the title lady.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，趙葵進三秩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on guichou Zhao Kui was advanced three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guichou, Zhao Kui was promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，日生赤黃暈周匝。

translations.literal: On yiyou the sun produced red-yellow halo encircling it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the sun was surrounded by a red-yellow halo.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以徐鹿卿爲樞密使兼參知政事兼侍講。

translations.literal: On wuxu Xu Luqing was made Commissioner of Military Affairs, concurrent Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs, and concurrent Lecturer-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Xu Luqing was appointed commissioner of military affairs, concurrent associate director of the Department of State Affairs, and concurrent lecturer-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，有流星出河鼓，大如太白。

translations.literal: On jiachen a meteor issued from the Drum at the River, as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a meteor issued from the Drum at the River, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，太白入井。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on wushen the Great White Star entered the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wushen, Venus entered the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以王伯大參知政事，應𢖟同知樞密院事，謝方叔簽書樞密院事，史宅之同簽書樞密院事，趙與𥲅資政殿學士，依舊知臨安府、浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: On xinhai Wang Boda was made Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Ying Li Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xie Fangshu Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Shi Zhaizhi Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zhao Yuyu Academician of the Zizheng Hall, continuing as Prefect of Lin'an and Zhexi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wang Boda was appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Ying Li vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xie Fangshu associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Shi Zhaizhi associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Zhao Yuyu academician of the Zizheng Hall, retaining his posts as prefect of Lin'an and Zhexi pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王伯大罷爲資政殿學士、知建寧府。

translations.literal: On guiyou Wang Boda was dismissed to Academician of the Zizheng Hall and Prefect of Jianning.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wang Boda was dismissed to academician of the Zizheng Hall and prefect of Jianning.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on xinyou sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall and a great amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou, sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 雷。

translations.literal: Thunder.
translations.idiomatic: There was thunder.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，別之傑三疏乞歸田裏，詔以資政殿大學士知紹興府。

translations.literal: On the new moon jiaxu of the tenth month of winter, Bie Zhijie three times memorialized begging to return to his rural estate; an edict made him Grand Academician of the Zizheng Hall and Prefect of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month of winter, jiaxu, Bie Zhijie three times memorialized asking to retire to his home district; an edict appointed him grand academician of the Zizheng Hall and prefect of Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，應𢖟、謝方叔並兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On yihai Ying Li and Xie Fangshu were both made concurrent Associate Directors of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Ying Li and Xie Fangshu were both appointed concurrent associate directors of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，余玠言：「都統制張實等以戰功，承制便宜與官三轉，給刺史象符、金銀器二百兩、銀三百兩、緡錢一萬，餘將士依等第轉官，給金銀符、錢帛有差。

translations.literal: On jimao Yu Jie reported: "Overall Controller Zhang Shi and others for battle merit, by provisional authority promptly granted three ranks, given prefectural elephant tally, two hundred taels of gold and silver vessels, three hundred taels of silver, ten thousand strings of cash; remaining officers and soldiers promoted by merit rank, granted gold and silver tallies and cash and silk in varying degrees."
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Yu Jie reported that Overall Controller Zhang Shi and others, for battle merit, had been promptly granted three ranks by provisional authority, with prefectural elephant tally, two hundred taels of gold and silver vessels, three hundred taels of silver, and ten thousand strings of cash; the remaining officers and soldiers were to be promoted by merit rank and granted gold and silver tallies, cash, and silk according to merit.

sentences.zh: 」詔命詞、給告身付之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered appointment documents drafted and patent of office issued to them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered appointment documents drafted and patents of office issued to them.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月乙巳，孟啟授慶遠軍節度使，進封益國公。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, first month of spring on yisi, Meng Qi was granted Military Commissioner of Qingyuan Army and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first month of spring, on yisi, Meng Qi was granted military commissioner of the Qingyuan Army and advanced in rank to Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔周世宗八世孫柴彥穎補承務郎，襲封崇義公。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict ordered the eighth-generation descendant of Emperor Shizong of Zhou, Chai Yanying, supplemented as Gentleman for Attending Affairs and to inherit enfeoffment as Duke of Chongyi.
