translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict appointed the eighth-generation descendant of Emperor Shizong of Zhou, Chai Yanying, as gentleman for attending affairs and granted him inheritance of the enfeoffment as Duke of Chongyi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔兩淮、京湖沿江曠土，軍民從便耕種，秋成日官不分收，制帥嚴勸諭覺察。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict ordered that idle land along the Yangzi in the Two Huai circuits and Jing-Hu be cultivated at convenience by troops and people; at autumn harvest officials were not to take shares; commanders were strictly to urge and oversee.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict ordered that idle land along the Yangzi in the Two Huai and Jing-Hu regions be cultivated at will by troops and civilians, with officials forbidden to take shares at harvest; commanders were to urge and oversee this strictly.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，詔給官田五百畝，命臨安府創慈幼局，收養道路遺棄初生嬰兒，仍置藥局療貧民疾病。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict granted five hundred mu of official fields, ordered Lin'an Prefecture to establish a Bureau for Cherishing the Young to take in newborn infants abandoned on the roads, and still to establish a pharmacy bureau to treat the illnesses of the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict granted five hundred mu of official fields and ordered Lin'an to establish a Bureau for Cherishing the Young to take in newborn infants abandoned on the roads, and also to establish a pharmacy to treat the illnesses of the poor.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雨雹。

translations.literal: On yichou, hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，許應龍薨。

translations.literal: On dingmao Xu Yinglong died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xu Yinglong died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，范鐘薨，贈少保，諡文肅。

translations.literal: On jisi Fan Zhong died; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian and given the posthumous title Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Fan Zhong died; he was posthumously granted junior guardian and given the posthumous title Wensu.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔以官田三百畝給表忠觀，旌錢氏功德，仍禁樵采。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict granted three hundred mu of official fields to the Hall for Manifesting Loyalty to honor the merit and virtue of the Qian clan, and still forbade cutting firewood.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict granted three hundred mu of official fields to the Hall for Manifesting Loyalty to honor the merit of the Qian clan, and forbade cutting firewood there.

sentences.zh: 閏二月甲辰，以鄭清之爲太師、左丞相兼樞密使，進封魏國公；

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month on jiachen Zheng Qingzhi was made Grand Preceptor, Left Chancellor, and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs, advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Wei;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on jiachen, Zheng Qingzhi was appointed grand preceptor, left chancellor, and concurrent commissioner of military affairs, and advanced in rank to Duke of Wei;

sentences.zh: 趙葵爲右丞相兼樞密使；

translations.literal: Zhao Kui was made Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Kui was appointed right chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs;

sentences.zh: 應𢖟、謝方叔並參知政事；

translations.literal: Ying Li and Xie Fangshu were both Associate Directors of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Ying Li and Xie Fangshu were both associate directors of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 史宅之同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Shi Zhaizhi was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhaizhi was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，鄭清之五辭免太師，許之。

translations.literal: On yimao Zheng Qingzhi five times declined the post of Grand Preceptor; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zheng Qingzhi five times declined the post of grand preceptor; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，以賈似道爲寶文閣學士、京湖安撫制置大使。

translations.literal: In the third month on guiwei Jia Sidao was made Academician of the Baowen Pavilion and Grand Ambassador for Jing-Hu Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei, Jia Sidao was appointed academician of the Baowen Pavilion and grand ambassador for Jing-Hu pacification.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，程元鳳江、淮等路都大提點坑冶鑄錢公事兼知饒州。

translations.literal: On yiyou Cheng Yuanfeng was made Grand Commissioner for Mining and Minting Affairs of the Jiang and Huai circuits, concurrent Prefect of Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Cheng Yuanfeng was appointed grand commissioner for mining and minting affairs of the Jiang and Huai circuits and concurrent prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔以四月朔日食，自二十一日避殿、減膳、徹樂。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict stated that on the new moon of the fourth month there would be an eclipse; from the twenty-first day withdraw from the hall, reduce meals, and remove music.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict noted that a solar eclipse was due on the new moon of the fourth month and ordered withdrawal from the main hall, reduced meals, and cessation of music from the twenty-first day.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the new moon renyin of the fourth month of summer there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fourth month of summer, renyin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，趙葵四辭免右丞相兼樞密使，詔不允。

translations.literal: On gengxu Zhao Kui four times declined the post of Right Chancellor and concurrent Commissioner of Military Affairs; the edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhao Kui four times declined the post of right chancellor and concurrent commissioner of military affairs; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，趙葵乞歸田裏，又不允。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jichou Zhao Kui begged to return to his rural estate; again it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jichou, Zhao Kui asked to retire to his home district; again the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 甲午，鄭寀薨。

translations.literal: On jiawu Zheng Cai died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zheng Cai died.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌晝，南方有星，急流至濁沒，大如太白。

translations.literal: In the sixth month during the day on renxu, in the south there was a star flowing swiftly to the Turbid and vanishing, as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, during the day on renxu, a star appeared in the south, flowing swiftly toward the Turbid and vanishing, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔邊郡各立廟一，賜額曰「褒忠」，凡沒于王事忠節顯著者並祠焉，守臣春秋致祀。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict ordered each border prefecture to establish one temple, granted the plaque title "Honoring Loyalty"; all who died in royal service with manifest loyal integrity were to be sacrificed there; prefects were to offer sacrifice in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict ordered each border prefecture to establish a temple with the plaque title Honoring Loyalty, to sacrifice to all who had died in royal service with manifest loyal integrity, with prefects offering sacrifice in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，詔知吉州李義山更削三秩，監贓錢銀納安邊所。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on renchen an edict ordered the Prefect of Ji Prefecture Li Yishan further reduced three ranks and to supervise payment of embezzled cash and silver to the Border Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, an edict ordered Li Yishan, prefect of Jizhou, further reduced three ranks and assigned to supervise payment of embezzled funds to the Border Pacification Office.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太白犯進賢星。

translations.literal: On guiyou the Great White Star transgressed the Promoting Worthies star.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Venus transgressed the Promoting Worthies star.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以吳潛爲資政殿學士、知紹興府、浙東安撫使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiyou Wu Qian was made Academician of the Zizheng Hall, Prefect of Shaoxing, and Zhedong Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, Wu Qian was appointed academician of the Zizheng Hall, prefect of Shaoxing, and Zhedong pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔趣趙葵治事，命吳淵宣諭赴闕。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict urged Zhao Kui to attend to affairs and ordered Wu Yuan to announce and instruct him to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict urged Zhao Kui to attend to affairs and ordered Wu Yuan to summon him to court.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，詔趙與𥲅提領戶部財用，置新倉，積貯百二十萬，名淳祐倉，許辟官四人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on bingzi an edict ordered Zhao Yuyu to superintend Ministry of Revenue finances, establish a new granary, store 1.2 million, named the Chunyou Granary, and permitted recruiting four officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingzi, an edict ordered Zhao Yuyu to superintend Ministry of Revenue finances, establish a new granary storing 1.2 million units, named the Chunyou Granary, with permission to recruit four officials.

sentences.zh: 乙未，冊命婉容閻氏爲貴妃。

translations.literal: On yiwei Graceful Lady of the Yan clan was enfeoffed as Honored Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Graceful Lady Yan was enfeoffed as honored consort.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，太白入氐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on xinchou the Great White Star entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou, Venus entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，諫臣周坦言：知建寧府楊棟任成都制幕時，盡載激賞庫珍寶先遁，陷丁黼於死，致全蜀生靈塗炭。

translations.literal: On dingmao remonstrating official Zhou Tan stated: When Prefect of Jianning Yang Dong served on the Chengdu commissioner staff, he loaded all the treasures of the Stimulus Reward Treasury and fled first, causing Ding Fu to die and bringing ruin to all the people of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao remonstrating official Zhou Tan reported that when Yang Dong, prefect of Jianning, had served on the Chengdu commissioner staff, he had loaded all the treasures of the Stimulus Reward Treasury and fled first, causing Ding Fu's death and bringing ruin to all the people of Shu.

sentences.zh: 詔褫棟閣職，罷新任。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Dong of his pavilion office and dismissed his new appointment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Dong of his pavilion office and dismissed his new appointment.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未，太白入氐。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on xinwei the Great White Star entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinwei, Venus entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 壬申，有流星出自織女星。

translations.literal: On renshen a meteor issued from the Weaving Maid star.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen a meteor issued from the Weaving Maid star.

sentences.zh: 丙子，趙與𥲅資政殿學士、提領國用、浙西安撫使。

translations.literal: On bingzi Zhao Yuyu was made Academician of the Zizheng Hall, Superintendent of State Revenue, and Zhexi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Zhao Yuyu was appointed academician of the Zizheng Hall, superintendent of state revenue, and Zhexi pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸未，應𢖟乞歸田裏，詔以資政殿學士知平江府。

translations.literal: On guiwei Ying Li begged to return to his rural estate; an edict made him Academician of the Zizheng Hall and Prefect of Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Ying Li asked to retire to his home district; an edict appointed him academician of the Zizheng Hall and prefect of Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，以董槐兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on jihai Dong Huai was made concurrent Reader-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, Dong Huai was appointed concurrent reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以吳潛同知樞密院事兼參知政事，徐清叟簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yisi Wu Qian was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Xu Qingsou Associate Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wu Qian was appointed vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrent associate director of the Department of State Affairs, and Xu Qingsou associate signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wushen the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊午，史宅之薨，贈少師。

translations.literal: On wuwu Shi Zhaizhi died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Shi Zhaizhi died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲午，應𢖟三乞歸田裏，與祠祿。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, first month of spring on jiawu, Ying Li three times begged to return to his rural estate; temple stipend was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, in the first month of spring, on jiawu, Ying Li three times asked to retire to his home district and was granted a temple stipend.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month on yimao, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, there was a fall of dust from the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，趙葵辭，以爲觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀，奉朝請。

translations.literal: In the third month on guiwei Zhao Kui declined; he was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Superintendent of Liquan Abbey and concurrent Reader-in-Waiting, attending court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei, Zhao Kui declined his post and was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, superintendent of the Liquan Abbey and concurrent reader-in-waiting, with attendance at court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以賈似道爲端明殿學士、兩淮制置大使、淮東安撫使、知揚州；

translations.literal: On gengyin Jia Sidao was made Academician of the Duanming Hall, Grand Ambassador for the Two Huai Pacification, Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, and Prefect of Yangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Jia Sidao was appointed academician of the Duanming Hall, grand ambassador for the Two Huai pacification, Huaidong pacification commissioner, and prefect of Yangzhou;

sentences.zh: 余玠龍圖閣學士，職任依舊；

translations.literal: Yu Jie Academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, duties continuing as before;
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jie was granted academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion, with duties unchanged;

sentences.zh: 李曾伯徽猷閣學士、京湖安撫制置使、知江陵府。

translations.literal: Li Zengbo Academician of the Huiyao Pavilion, Jing-Hu Pacification Commissioner, and Prefect of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zengbo was appointed academician of the Huiyao Pavilion, Jing-Hu pacification commissioner, and prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 丙申，有流星夕隕。

translations.literal: On bingshen a meteor fell in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen a meteor fell in the evening.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，幸龍翔宮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on jiyou the Emperor visited the Dragon Soaring Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiyou, the emperor visited the Dragon Soaring Palace.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅朔，以福州觀察使、提舉佑神觀善珘爲保康軍節度使、提舉萬壽觀、嗣濮王；

translations.literal: On the new moon bingyin of the fifth month, Fuzhou Observation Commissioner and Superintendent of the You Spirit Abbey Shan Pin was made Military Commissioner of Baokang Army, Superintendent of Longevity Abbey, and Heir Apparent Prince of Pu;
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, bingyin, Fuzhou observation commissioner and superintendent of the You Spirit Abbey Shan Pin was appointed military commissioner of the Baokang Army, superintendent of the Longevity Abbey, and heir apparent prince of Pu;

sentences.zh: 吳淵資政殿學士，依舊職任，與執政恩數。

translations.literal: Wu Yuan Academician of the Zizheng Hall, continuing his duties as before, with the favors of the chief administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuan was granted academician of the Zizheng Hall, retaining his previous duties, with the privileges of the chief administrators.

sentences.zh: 癸未，賈似道言王登浚築江陵城濠有勞，詔登初官選人，減舉主三員。

translations.literal: On guiwei Jia Sidao reported that Wang Deng had merit in dredging the moat of Jiangling city; an edict ordered Deng initially appointed as Selected Person, reducing recommending sponsors by three.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Jia Sidao reported that Wang Deng had distinguished himself in dredging the moat of Jiangling; an edict appointed Deng as selected person and reduced his required recommending sponsors by three.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，台州大水。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiayin Taizhou suffered great flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, Taizhou suffered severe flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子朔，賈似道兼淮西安撫使。

translations.literal: On the new moon jiazi of the ninth month Jia Sidao was additionally made Huai West Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the ninth month, jiazi, Jia Sidao was additionally appointed Huai West pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，賜禮部進士方夢魁以下五百一十三人及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On jisi the Ministry of Rites jinshi Fang Mengkui and five hundred thirteen others were granted passage of the examinations and entry into service in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Ministry of Rites jinshi Fang Mengkui and five hundred thirteen others were granted examination success and official appointment in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，進士第一名方夢魁改賜名逢辰。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the first-ranked jinshi Fang Mengkui was changed and granted the name Fengchen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the top jinshi graduate Fang Mengkui was granted the new name Fengchen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以嚴州水，復民田租。

translations.literal: On wuyin, on account of flooding in Yan Prefecture, the people's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, on account of flooding in Yanzhou, land taxes for the people were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，詔郡邑間有水患，其被災細民，隨處發義倉振之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on dingyou an edict ordered that wherever prefectures and counties had water calamity, the afflicted common people were to be relieved by disbursing from charity granaries wherever they were.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingyou, an edict ordered that wherever prefectures and counties suffered flooding, afflicted commoners were to be relieved by disbursing from charity granaries on the spot.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔諸主兵官今後行罰，毋杖脊以傷人命。

translations.literal: On xinyou an edict ordered that hereafter when military officers imposed punishment, they were not to flog the back so as to injure life.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict forbade military officers from flogging the back in punishment so as to endanger life.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，趙葵授特進，依舊觀文殿大學士、判潭州、湖南安撫大使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on renshen Zhao Kui was granted Special Advancement, continuing as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, Administrator of Tan Prefecture, and Grand Ambassador for Hunan Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renshen, Zhao Kui was granted special advancement, retaining his posts as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature, administrator of Tanzhou, and grand ambassador for Hunan pacification.

sentences.zh: 壬午，雷。

translations.literal: On renwu, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以雷震非時，自二十四日避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On guiwei, on account of thunder out of season, from the twenty-fourth day the court withdrew from the hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, on account of unseasonable thunder, the court withdrew from the main hall and reduced meals from the twenty-fourth day.

sentences.zh: 詔：「公卿大夫百執事各揚乃職，裨朕不逮。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Dukes, ministers, grandees, and the hundred officers each display your duties and supplement my shortcomings."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that dukes, ministers, grandees, and all officers should each discharge their duties and remedy the emperor's shortcomings.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事謝方叔、吳潛、簽書樞密院事徐清叟並乞解機政，詔不允。

translations.literal: Associate Directors Xie Fangshu and Wu Qian and Associate Signatory Xu Qingsou all begged to resign from core governance; the edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Associate directors Xie Fangshu and Wu Qian and associate signatory Xu Qingsou all asked to resign from core governance; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰朔，鄭清之乞歸田裏，詔不允。

translations.literal: On the new moon renchen of the twelfth month Zheng Qingzhi begged to return to his rural estate; the edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, renchen, Zheng Qingzhi asked to retire to his home district; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白、歲星合于危。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Great White Star and Jupiter conjoined in the Rooftop mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Venus and Jupiter conjoined in the Rooftop mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，虹見。

translations.literal: On dingsi a rainbow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a rainbow appeared.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月丁卯，詔孟啟改賜名孜，依前慶遠軍節度使，進封建安郡王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, first month of spring on dingmao, an edict ordered Meng Qi changed and granted the name Zi, continuing as Military Commissioner of Qingyuan Army, advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Jian'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, in the first month of spring, on dingmao, an edict granted Meng Qi the new name Zi, retaining his post as military commissioner of the Qingyuan Army, and advanced him to prince of Jian'an commandery.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔沿海沿江州郡，申嚴水軍之制。

translations.literal: On jichou an edict ordered coastal and Yangzi prefectures and counties strictly to enforce the naval forces regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict ordered coastal and Yangzi prefectures and counties strictly to enforce naval regulations.

sentences.zh: 監察御史程元鳳言：資善堂宜選用重厚篤實之士。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Cheng Yuanfeng stated: The Hall for Nurturing Goodness should select weighty, solid, and sincere scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Cheng Yuanfeng stated that the Hall for Nurturing Goodness should select weighty, solid, and sincere scholars.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted the advice.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，左丞相鄭清之等上《玉牒》、《日曆》、《會要》及《光宗寧宗寶訓》、《寧宗經武要略》。

translations.literal: In the second month on yiwei Left Chancellor Zheng Qingzhi and others presented the Jade Genealogy, Calendar, Essentials, and the Imperial Instructions of Guangzong and Ningzong and Essentials of Military Classics of Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Left Chancellor Zheng Qingzhi and others presented the Jade Genealogy, the Calendar, the Essentials, the Imperial Instructions of Guangzong and Ningzong, and the Essentials of Military Classics of Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔清之等各進秩有差。

translations.literal: On dingyou an edict ordered Qingzhi and others each advanced in rank in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict ordered promotions for Qingzhi and others according to merit.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遊似乞致仕，詔依舊觀文殿大學士、進二秩。

translations.literal: On gengzi You Si begged to retire from office; an edict granted him continuing as Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi You Si asked to retire from office; an edict granted him continued status as grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and promoted him two ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太白犯昴。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Great White Star transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Venus transgressed the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On yimao the Great White Star was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，少保、保寧軍節度使、嗣濮王不擅薨，贈少師，追封新興郡王。

translations.literal: In the third month on dingmao Junior Guardian, Military Commissioner of Baoning Army, and Heir Apparent Prince of Pu Shan Pin died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xinxing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingmao, Junior Guardian, military commissioner of the Baoning Army, and heir apparent prince of Pu, Shan Pin, died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor and enfeoffed as prince of Xinxing commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雨土。

translations.literal: On yihai, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai there was a fall of dust from the sky.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以謝方叔知樞密院、參知政事，吳潛參知政事，徐清叟同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On wuyin Xie Fangshu was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wu Qian Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Xu Qingsou Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Xie Fangshu was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and associate director of the Department of State Affairs; Wu Qian associate director of the Department of State Affairs; and Xu Qingsou vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，城寶應，詔移一軍戍守。

translations.literal: On xinsi Baoying was walled; an edict ordered one army transferred to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Baoying was fortified; an edict ordered one army transferred to garrison it.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝進一秩，將士推恩有差。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi was advanced one rank; officers and soldiers rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi was promoted one rank, and officers and soldiers were rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 俞興升成都安撫副使、知嘉定府，任責威、茂、黎、雅邊防。

translations.literal: Yu Xing was promoted to Vice Commissioner of Chengdu Pacification and Prefect of Jia Prefecture, charged with border defense of Wei, Mao, Li, and Ya.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xing was promoted to vice commissioner of Chengdu pacification and prefect of Jia, charged with border defense of Wei, Mao, Li, and Ya.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，潭州民林符三世孝行，一門義居，福州陳氏，笄年守志，壽逾九袠，詔皆旌表其門。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on wuxu the Tan Prefecture commoner Lin Fu had three generations of filial conduct and one household dwelling in righteousness; the Chen clan of Fuzhou, at hairpin age upheld her integrity, longevity exceeding ninety years—an edict ordered all their gates honored with plaques.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuxu, the Tanzhou commoner Lin Fu showed three generations of filial conduct and one household dwelling in righteousness; the Chen clan of Fuzhou, who at hairpin age had upheld her integrity and lived beyond ninety years, were all honored with commemorative plaques at their gates.

sentences.zh: 丁未，進《淳祐條法事類》凡四百三十篇，鄭清之等各進二秩。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Chunyou Compendium of Statutes and Cases in four hundred thirty sections was presented; Zheng Qingzhi and others each advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Chunyou Compendium of Statutes and Cases, in four hundred thirty sections, was presented, and Zheng Qingzhi and others were each promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，四川余玠奏進北馬五百，詔立功將士趣上姓名推恩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on jiawu Sichuan Yu Jie memorialized presenting five hundred northern horses; an edict ordered meritorious officers and soldiers to submit names promptly for reward.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, Yu Jie of Sichuan memorialized presenting five hundred northern horses; an edict ordered meritorious officers and soldiers to submit names promptly for reward.

sentences.zh: 丙申，高達帶行遙郡刺史、權知襄陽府、管內安撫、節制屯戍軍馬。

translations.literal: On bingshen Gao Da was granted acting Remote Prefecture Governor, Acting Prefect of Xiangyang, Administrator Within the Circuit, and Controller of Garrison Troops and Horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Gao Da was granted acting remote prefectural governor, acting prefect of Xiangyang, administrator within the circuit, and controller of garrison troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔求遺書並山林之士有著述者，許上進。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict sought lost books and scholars in mountains and forests who had writings; submission was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict sought lost books and writings by scholars in reclusion, permitting their submission to the throne.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑朔，流星夕隕。

translations.literal: On the new moon jichou of the eighth month a meteor fell in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month, jichou, a meteor fell in the evening.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On guisi the Moon entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Moon entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，熒惑入井。

translations.literal: On dingyou Mars entered the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Mars entered the Well mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命呂文福廬州駐紮御前諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: On dingwei Lü Wenfu was ordered Overall Controller of all Imperial Front armies garrisoned at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Lü Wenfu was appointed overall controller of all Imperial Front armies garrisoned at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔以故直龍圖閣樓昉所著《中興小傳》百篇、《宋十朝綱目》並《撮要》二書，付史館謄寫，昉追贈龍圖閣待制。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict ordered the late Direct Attendant of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion Lou Fang's Hundred Chapters of the Minor Biography of the Restoration, Song Ten Reigns Outline, and two books of Extracts handed to the History Institute for transcription; Fang was posthumously granted Attendant Gentleman of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict ordered the late Lou Fang's Hundred Chapters of the Minor Biography of the Restoration, Song Ten Reigns Outline, and two books of Extracts handed to the History Institute for transcription; Fang was posthumously granted attendant gentleman of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔：「比覽林光世《易範》，明《易》推星配象演義，有司其以禮津遣赴闕。」

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict stated: "Recently perusing Lin Guangshi's Paradigms of the Changes, which elucidates the Changes, deduces stars, matches images, and expounds meaning—the relevant offices shall with proper rites escort him to court."
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict noted that after reviewing Lin Guangshi's Paradigms of the Changes, which elucidates the Changes, correlates stars with images, and expounds their meaning, the relevant offices were to escort him to court with proper ceremony.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，祀明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on xinwei sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall and a great amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, sacrifice was offered at the Bright Hall and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 閏十月癸丑，太白入氐。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month on guichou the Great White Star entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, on guichou, Venus entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，吳潛五疏乞罷機政，不允。

translations.literal: On guiyou Wu Qian five times memorialized begging to resign from core governance; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wu Qian five times memorialized asking to resign from core governance; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，詔以八事訓飭在廷，曰肅紀綱、用正人、救楮幣、固邊陲、清吏道、淑士氣、定軍制、結人心。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on wuchen an edict admonished the court with eight matters: rectify discipline and standards, employ upright men, rescue paper currency, secure the borders, cleanse the official way, refine scholarly spirit, fix military regulations, and bind people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, an edict admonished the court with eight matters: rectify discipline, employ upright men, rescue paper currency, secure the borders, cleanse official conduct, refine scholarly spirit, fix military regulations, and win the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遊似薨，贈少師，諡清獻。

translations.literal: On jimao You Si died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and given the posthumous title Qingxian.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao You Si died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor and given the posthumous title Qingxian.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月癸巳，武功大夫王堅以復興元功，轉遙郡團練使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, first month of spring on guisi, Martial Achievement Grandee Wang Jian for merit in recovering Xingyuan was transferred to Remote Prefecture Militia Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the first month of spring, on guisi, Martial Achievement Grandee Wang Jian, for merit in recovering Xingyuan, was transferred to remote prefecture militia commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太學錄楊懋卿以孝行卓異，詔表其門，以其事宣付史館。

translations.literal: On xinchou Imperial University Recorder Yang Maoqing for outstanding filial conduct had his gate honored with a plaque by edict, and the matter announced and handed to the History Institute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Imperial University recorder Yang Maoqing, for outstanding filial conduct, had his gate honored with a commemorative plaque by edict, and the matter was announced and recorded by the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔宰執議立方田，開溝澮，自近圻始。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict ordered the chief administrators to deliberate on establishing the square fields system and opening canals and ditches, beginning from the near capital districts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict ordered the chief administrators to deliberate on establishing the square fields system and opening canals and ditches, beginning from the districts near the capital.

sentences.zh: 創置遊擊軍，水步各半。

translations.literal: Raider armies were newly established, half naval and half infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Raider armies were newly established, half naval and half infantry.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the new moon yimao of the second month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, yimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 巳未，詔陳顯伯資善堂翊善，蔡抗資善堂贊讀、翁甫資善堂直講。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict ordered Chen Xianbo Companion of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness; Cai Kang Reader of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness; Weng Fu Direct Lecturer of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict appointed Chen Xianbo companion of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness, Cai Kang reader of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness, and Weng Fu direct lecturer of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔襄、郢新復州縣，賦稅復三年。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict ordered that in the newly recovered prefectures and counties of Xiang and Ying, taxes were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict ordered a three-year remission of taxes in the newly recovered prefectures and counties of Xiang and Ying.

sentences.zh: 大元兵數萬攻隨、郢、安、復，京西馬步軍副總管馬榮率將士戰嚴竇山。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops in the tens of thousands attacked Sui, Ying, An, and Fu; Jingxi Horse and Foot Army Deputy Overall Controller Ma Rong led officers and soldiers in battle at Mount Yan Dou.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces numbering tens of thousands attacked Sui, Ying, An, and Fu; Jingxi horse and foot army deputy overall controller Ma Rong led officers and soldiers in battle at Mount Yan Dou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，再戰銅冶坪。

translations.literal: On guiwei they fought again at Copper Smelting Flat.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei they fought again at Copper Smelting Flat.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，又戰子陵大脊山。

translations.literal: In the third month on dinghai they fought again at Ziling Great Ridge Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dinghai, they fought again at Ziling Great Ridge Mountain.

sentences.zh: 詔榮兵不滿千，能禦大難，賞官兩轉，進州鈐，帶行閣門祗候，賜金帶。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Rong's troops were fewer than a thousand yet could withstand great calamity; reward two ranks, advance to Prefectural Controller, grant acting Palace Gate Attendant, and bestow gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict noted that Rong's force of fewer than a thousand had withstood a major attack; he was rewarded with two ranks, promoted to prefectural controller, granted acting palace gate attendant, and bestowed a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 諸將王成、楊進各官兩轉升遷，餘推恩有差。

translations.literal: The generals Wang Cheng and Yang Jin each advanced two ranks in promotion; the rest rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Wang Cheng and Yang Jin were each promoted two ranks, and the others were rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 丁未，守三氵義口諸將焚北屯積蓄，斷其浮梁。

translations.literal: On dingwei the generals defending Sanyi Kou burned the northern encampment's stores and severed their pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the generals defending Sanyi Kou burned the northern encampment's stores and severed the enemy pontoon bridge.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，有流星出自角、亢，大如太白。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on gengshen a meteor issued from the Horn and Neck mansions, as large as the Great White Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengshen, a meteor issued from the Horn and Neck mansions, as large as Venus.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔襄、郢新復州郡，耕屯爲急，以緡錢百萬命京閫措置，給種與牛。

translations.literal: On wuchen an edict ordered that in the newly recovered prefectures and commanderies of Xiang and Ying, farming colonies were urgent; one million strings were ordered for the capital garrison to arrange, providing seed and oxen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen an edict ordered that in the newly recovered prefectures of Xiang and Ying, farming colonies were the urgent priority; one million strings were allocated to the capital garrison for arrangements, including seed and oxen.

sentences.zh: 壬申，熒惑犯權星。

translations.literal: On renshen Mars transgressed the Power star.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Mars transgressed the Power star.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，葵抗兼侍立修注官。

translations.literal: On yihai Kui Kang was made concurrent Attendant for Revision and Annotation.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Kui Kang was appointed concurrent attendant for revision and annotation.

sentences.zh: 丙子，置池州遊擊水軍。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Chizhou Raider Naval Force was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Chizhou raider naval force was established.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申朔，祈雨。

translations.literal: On the new moon jiashen of the fifth month prayers for rain were offered.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the fifth month, jiashen, prayers for rain were offered.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔申儆江防，每歲以葺戰艦、練舟師勤惰爲殿最賞罰。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict urgently warned Yangzi defenses; each year the repair of war vessels and training of naval forces, diligence and idleness, were ranked best and worst for reward and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict urgently warned the Yangzi defenses; each year the repair of war vessels and training of naval forces were to be ranked for reward and punishment according to diligence or neglect.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，盜起信州玉山縣。

translations.literal: On yisi bandits rose in Yushan County, Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi bandits broke out in Yushan County, Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 罷諸郡經界。

translations.literal: The land-survey boundaries in all prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Land-survey boundaries in all prefectures were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太陰犯畢。

translations.literal: On wushen the Moon transgressed the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Moon transgressed the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，發米三萬石振衢、信饑、玉山寇平。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on guihai thirty thousand shi of rice were disbursed to relieve famine in Qu and Xin; the Yushan bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai, thirty thousand shi of rice were disbursed to relieve famine in Quzhou and Xinzhou; the Yushan bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，嚴、衢、婺、台、處、上饒、建寧、南劍、邵武大水，遣使分行振恤存問，除今年田租。

translations.literal: On bingyin Yan, Qu, Wu, Tai, Chu, Shangrao, Jianning, Nanjian, and Shaowu suffered great flooding; envoys were dispatched in separate routes to relieve, comfort, and inquire, and this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Yan, Qu, Wu, Tai, Chu, Shangrao, Jianning, Nanjian, and Shaowu suffered severe flooding; envoys were dispatched to relieve and comfort the afflicted, and this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，太白、熒惑合於軫。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on gengyin the Great White Star and Mars conjoined in the Chariot mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengyin, Venus and Mars conjoined in the Chariot mansion.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，詔來年省試仍舊用二月一日，殿試用四月十五日以前，庶免滯留遠方士子。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on jiwei an edict ordered that next year's provincial examination still use the first day of the second month and the palace examination before the fifteenth day of the fourth month, so as to avoid detaining scholars from distant regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiwei, an edict ordered that the following year's provincial examination would still be held on the first day of the second month and the palace examination before the fifteenth day of the fourth month, so as to avoid detaining scholars from distant regions.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔以緡錢四十萬振恤在京軍民。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict granted four hundred thousand strings to relieve troops and people in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict granted four hundred thousand strings to relieve troops and civilians in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔行《會天曆》。

translations.literal: On dingchou an edict ordered implementation of the Calendar for Harmonizing Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict ordered implementation of the Calendar for Harmonizing Heaven.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔改明年爲寶祐元年。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict ordered the coming year changed to the first year of Baoyou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict changed the coming year to the first year of Baoyou.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，少師、保康軍節度使、嗣沂王貴謙薨，贈太傅，追封申王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on dinghai Junior Preceptor, Military Commissioner of Baokang Army, and Heir Apparent Prince of Yi Gui Qian died; he was posthumously granted Grand Tutor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince Shen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Junior Preceptor, military commissioner of the Baokang Army, and heir apparent prince of Yi, Gui Qian, died; he was posthumously granted grand tutor and enfeoffed as Prince Shen.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白、填星合於箕。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Great White Star and Saturn conjoined in the Winnowing Basket mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Venus and Saturn conjoined in the Winnowing Basket mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白犯鬥。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Great White Star transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Venus transgressed the Dipper mansion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，以徐清叟參知政事，董槐同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on guichou Xu Qingsou was made Associate Director of the Department of State Affairs; Dong Huai Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guichou, Xu Qingsou was appointed associate director of the Department of State Affairs, and Dong Huai vice commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 嗣濮王善珘薨，贈少師、追封咸寧郡王。

translations.literal: Heir Apparent Prince of Pu Shan Pin died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor and posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Xianning Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Heir Apparent Prince of Pu Shan Pin died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor and enfeoffed as prince of Xianning commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，濮安懿王長孫善奐福州觀察使、提舉佑神觀、嗣濮王。

translations.literal: On wuwu the eldest grandson of Prince An Yi of Pu, Shan Huan, was made Fuzhou Observation Commissioner, Superintendent of the You Spirit Abbey, and Heir Apparent Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the eldest grandson of Prince An Yi of Pu, Shan Huan, was appointed Fuzhou observation commissioner, superintendent of the You Spirit Abbey, and heir apparent prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔襄、樊已復，其務措置屯田，修渠堰。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict stated that Xiang and Fan had been recovered; they were to arrange military colonies and repair canals and dikes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an edict noted that Xiang and Fan had been recovered and ordered arrangements for military colonies and repair of canals and dikes.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，吳潛罷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on gengyin Wu Qian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Wu Qian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙申夜，臨安火；

translations.literal: On the night of bingshen Lin'an caught fire;
translations.idiomatic: On the night of bingshen a fire broke out in Lin'an;

sentences.zh: 丁酉夜，火乃熄。

translations.literal: on the night of dingyou the fire then went out.
translations.idiomatic: on the night of dingyou the fire was extinguished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict ordered withdrawal from the hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict ordered withdrawal from the main hall and reduced meals.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔求直言。

translations.literal: On renyin an edict sought frank speech.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict called for frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，以吳潛爲觀文殿大學士、提舉江州太平興國宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on yimao Wu Qian was made Grand Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Superintendent of the Taiping Xingguo Abbey in Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, Wu Qian was appointed grand academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and superintendent of the Taiping Xingguo Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔追錄彭大雅創城渝州功，復承議郎，官其子。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict ordered posthumous recording of Peng Daya's merit in founding the walls of Yu Prefecture; restored as Gentleman for Discussion, and his son appointed to office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict posthumously recorded Peng Daya's merit in founding the walls of Yuzhou, restored him to gentleman for discussion, and appointed his son to office.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔海神爲大祀，春秋遣從臣奉命往祠，奉常其條具典禮來上。

translations.literal: On guihai an edict ordered the Sea Spirit as a great sacrifice; in spring and autumn attendant ministers were dispatched on command to sacrifice; the Director of Ceremonies was to submit the rites in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict elevated the Sea Spirit to great sacrifice status; in spring and autumn attendant ministers were to be dispatched to perform the rites, and the director of ceremonies was to submit the ritual regulations in detail.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰入氐。

translations.literal: On renshen the Moon entered the Root mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Moon entered the Root mansion.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，立春，雷。

translations.literal: On dingchou, at the Beginning of Spring, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, at the Beginning of Spring, there was thunder.

sentences.zh: 寶祐元年春正月庚寅朔，詔以藝祖嫡系十一世孫嗣榮王與芮之子建安郡王孜爲皇子，改賜名禥，授崇慶軍節度使，進封永嘉郡王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoyou, first month of spring, on the new moon gengyin, an edict ordered the eleventh-generation descendant in the direct line of Founder Taizu, the son of Heir Apparent Prince of Rong You Rui, Prince of Jian'an Commandery Zi, made Imperial Son; changed and granted the name Qi; granted Military Commissioner of Chongqing Army; advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Yongjia Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoyou, on the new moon of the first month of spring, gengyin, an edict made Zi, son of Heir Apparent Prince of Rong You Rui and eleventh-generation descendant in the direct line of Founder Taizu, an imperial son, granted him the new name Qi, appointed him military commissioner of the Chongqing Army, and advanced him to prince of Yongjia commandery.

sentences.zh: 制《資善堂記》賜皇子。

translations.literal: He composed the Record of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness and bestowed it on the Imperial Son.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed the Record of the Hall for Nurturing Goodness and bestowed it on the imperial son.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，日生戴氣。

translations.literal: On wuxu the sun produced coronal aura.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the sun showed a coronal aura.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大元兵渡漢江，屯萬州，入西柳關。

translations.literal: On guimao Great Yuan troops crossed the Han River, encamped at Wan Prefecture, and entered West Willow Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Great Yuan forces crossed the Han River, encamped at Wanzhou, and entered West Willow Pass.

sentences.zh: 高達調將士扼河關，上山大戰，至鱉坑、石碑港而還。

translations.literal: Gao Da deployed officers and soldiers to hold the river passes, fought a great battle in the mountains, and returned as far as Turtle Pit and Stone Tablet Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Da deployed officers and soldiers to hold the river passes, fought a major battle in the mountains, and withdrew as far as Turtle Pit and Stone Tablet Harbor.

sentences.zh: 詔高達、程大元、李和各官兩轉，餘恩賞有差。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Gao Da, Cheng Dayuan, and Li He each advanced two ranks; the rest rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Gao Da, Cheng Dayuan, and Li He each promoted two ranks, with the others rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the new moon jiyou of the second month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the second month, jiyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，陳垓貪贓不法，竄潮州。

translations.literal: On wuchen Chen Gai was greedy and corrupt and unlawful; he was banished to Chao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Chen Gai, for greed and corruption, was banished to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，罷尚書省，創置呈白房。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Department of State Affairs was abolished and the Memorial Presentation Office newly established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Department of State Affairs was abolished and the Memorial Presentation Office was newly established.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，與芮授少師，加食邑七百戶；

translations.literal: In the third month on wuzi You Rui was granted Junior Preceptor and increased fief income by seven hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, You Rui was granted junior preceptor and an increase of seven hundred households in fief income;

sentences.zh: 希邐檢少傅，加食邑五百戶；

translations.literal: Xi Li was inspected as Junior Tutor and increased fief income by five hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: Xi Li was granted junior tutor and an increase of five hundred households in fief income;

sentences.zh: 與歡授少保，加食邑七百戶；

translations.literal: You Huan was granted Junior Guardian and increased fief income by seven hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: You Huan was granted junior guardian and an increase of seven hundred households in fief income;

sentences.zh: 乃裕保康軍節度使，加食邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Nai Yu was made Military Commissioner of Baokang Army and increased fief income by five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Nai Yu was appointed military commissioner of the Baokang Army with an increase of five hundred households in fief income.

sentences.zh: 丙申，別之傑薨，贈少師。

translations.literal: On bingshen Bie Zhijie died; he was posthumously granted Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Bie Zhijie died; he was posthumously granted junior preceptor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，有流星大如太白。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on dingsi a meteor as large as the Great White Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, a meteor as large as Venus appeared.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，詔余玠赴闕。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on jiawu an edict ordered Yu Jie to proceed to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, an edict ordered Yu Jie to come to court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔侍從、台諫、給舍、制司各舉帥才二人。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, censorial remonstrators, draft reviewers, and commissioners each to recommend two men of commander talent.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict ordered attendants-in-waiting, censorial remonstrators, draft reviewers, and commissioners each to recommend two men of commander talent.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，熒惑、歲星合在昴。

translations.literal: On dingyou Mars and Jupiter conjoined in the Hairy Head mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Mars and Jupiter conjoined in the Hairy Head mansion.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賜禮部進士姚勉以下及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On jihai the Ministry of Rites jinshi Yao Mian and others below were granted passage of the examinations and entry into service in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Ministry of Rites jinshi Yao Mian and others were granted examination success and official appointment in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未朔，以馬光祖爲司農卿、淮西總領財賦。

translations.literal: On the new moon dingwei of the eighth month Ma Guangzu was made Minister of Agriculture and Huaixi Fiscal Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month, dingwei, Ma Guangzu was appointed minister of agriculture and Huaixi fiscal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，起居郎蕭泰來出知隆興府。

translations.literal: On jiayin Attendant Gentleman of the Palace Xiao Tailai went out as Prefect of Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin attendant gentleman of the palace Xiao Tailai was appointed prefect of Longxing.

sentences.zh: 先是，起居舍人牟子才與泰來並除，子才四疏辭，極陳泰來奸險汙穢，恥與爲伍，泰來不得已，請祠，遂予郡。

translations.literal: Earlier, Attendant Gentleman of the Palace Mou Zicai and Tailai were both appointed; Zicai four times memorialized to decline, stating at length that Tailai was treacherous, dangerous, and filthy, ashamed to be his associate; Tailai had no choice but to request a temple post and was then given a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, attendant gentleman of the palace Mou Zicai and Tailai had been appointed together; Zicai four times memorialized to decline, stating at length that Tailai was treacherous and corrupt and that he was ashamed to serve alongside him; Tailai had no choice but to request a temple post and was then given a prefectural appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以余晦權刑部侍郎、四川安撫制置使、知重慶府兼四川總領財賦。

translations.literal: On bingchen Yu Hui was made Acting Vice Minister of Justice, Sichuan Pacification Commissioner, Prefect of Chongqing, and concurrent Sichuan Fiscal Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yu Hui was appointed acting vice minister of justice, Sichuan pacification commissioner, prefect of Chongqing, and concurrent Sichuan fiscal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，行皇宋元寶錢。

translations.literal: On yichou the Huang Song Yuanbao coins were put into circulation.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Huang Song Yuanbao coins were put into circulation.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，程元鳳升兼侍讀，牟子才升兼侍講。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renwu Cheng Yuanfeng was promoted to concurrent Reader-in-Waiting; Mou Zicai promoted to concurrent Lecturer-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, Cheng Yuanfeng was promoted to concurrent reader-in-waiting, and Mou Zicai to concurrent lecturer-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，城夔門。

translations.literal: On renchen the walls of Kuimen were built.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the walls of Kuimen were fortified.

sentences.zh: 太陰入畢。

translations.literal: The Moon entered the Net mansion.
translations.idiomatic: The Moon entered the Net mansion.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午朔，詔出緡錢二百萬，振恤京城軍民。

translations.literal: On the new moon bingwu of the tenth month of winter an edict disbursed two million strings to relieve troops and people in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the tenth month of winter, bingwu, an edict disbursed two million strings to relieve troops and civilians in the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子朔，詔獎諭襄陽守臣高達。

translations.literal: On the new moon bingzi of the eleventh month an edict praised and instructed the defender of Xiangyang, Gao Da.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month, bingzi, an edict praised and instructed the defender of Xiangyang, Gao Da.

sentences.zh: 己丑，賈似道獻所獲良馬，賜詔褒嘉，其將士增秩、賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On jichou Jia Sidao presented fine horses he had obtained; an edict was granted to praise and commend; his officers and soldiers advanced in rank and rewarded in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Jia Sidao presented fine horses he had obtained; an edict praised and commended him, and his officers and soldiers were promoted and rewarded according to merit.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，冊瑞國公主。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on yimao the Princess of Ruiguo was enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yimao, the Princess of Ruiguo was enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，劉伯正薨，贈五秩。

translations.literal: On gengshen Liu Bozheng died; he was posthumously granted five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Liu Bozheng died; he was posthumously granted five ranks.
